db-13.complexity: Recursive CTEs for trend projection, multiple window functions with different frame clauses, correlation calculations, predictive analytics, joins across model_adoption_metrics/model_performance_metrics/model_pricing_history
db-13.expected_output: Analysis report with comprehensive metrics and insights for query 5
db-13.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE adoption_trends AS (
    SELECT
        mam.model_id,
        mam.metric_date,
        mam.market_penetration_percent,
        mam.active_users_thousands,
        mam.api_calls_millions,
        mam.developer_sentiment_score,
        am.model_name,
        am.creator_company,
        mpm.intelligence_index_score,
        mpm.output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
        mph.blended_price_per_million_tokens
    FROM model_adoption_metrics mam
    INNER JOIN ai_models am ON mam.model_id = am.model_id
    LEFT JOIN model_performance_metrics mpm ON mam.model_id = mpm.model_id
        AND ABS((mam.metric_date - mpm.evaluation_date)) <= 30
    LEFT JOIN model_pricing_history mph ON mam.model_id = mph.model_id
        AND ABS((mam.metric_date - mph.pricing_date)) <= 30
    WHERE mam.metric_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
        at.model_id,
        (at.metric_date + INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS metric_date,
        at.market_penetration_percent,
        at.active_users_thousands,
        at.api_calls_millions,
        at.developer_sentiment_score,
        at.model_name,
        at.creator_company,
        at.intelligence_index_score,
        at.output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
        at.blended_price_per_million_tokens
    FROM adoption_trends at
    WHERE at.metric_date < CURRENT_DATE
        AND at.metric_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
),
performance_correlation AS (
    SELECT
        at.*,
        AVG(at.market_penetration_percent) OVER (
            PARTITION BY at.model_id
            ORDER BY at.metric_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_penetration_30d,
        AVG(at.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY at.model_id
            ORDER BY at.metric_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_intelligence_30d,
        CORR(at.intelligence_index_score, at.market_penetration_percent) OVER (
            PARTITION BY at.model_id
            ORDER BY at.metric_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 89 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS performance_adoption_correlation
    FROM adoption_trends at
)
SELECT
    model_name,
    creator_company,
    metric_date,
    ROUND(CAST(market_penetration_percent AS NUMERIC), 2) AS market_penetration_percent,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_avg_penetration_30d AS NUMERIC), 2) AS moving_avg_penetration_30d,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_index_score AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_index_score,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_avg_intelligence_30d AS NUMERIC), 4) AS moving_avg_intelligence_30d,
    ROUND(CAST(performance_adoption_correlation AS NUMERIC), 4) AS performance_adoption_correlation,
    active_users_thousands,
    api_calls_millions,
    developer_sentiment_score,
    output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
    blended_price_per_million_tokens
FROM performance_correlation
WHERE metric_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
ORDER BY model_id, metric_date DESC;

db-13.title: Model Performance Trajectory Analysis with Temporal Clustering
db-13.description: Description: Analyzes model performance trajectories over time using temporal clustering, identifying performance trends, degradation patterns, and improvement cycles. Uses multiple CTEs with window functions for trajectory analysis, temporal clustering algorithms, and performance trend detection. Use Case: Performance monitoring for AI model providers - track model performance evolution and identify degradation or improvement patterns Business Value: Enables AI companies to monitor model perfor
db-13.complexity: Multiple CTEs (7+ levels), window functions with complex frame clauses, temporal clustering algorithms, performance trend detection, joins across model_performance_history/ai_models/benchmark_evaluations
db-13.expected_output: Performance trajectory analysis with clustering results, trend indicators, and lifecycle stage identification
db-13.sql:
WITH performance_timeline AS (
    SELECT
        mph.model_id,
        mph.performance_date AS evaluation_date,
        mph.intelligence_index_score,
        mph.output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
        mph.latency_seconds,
        am.model_name,
        am.creator_company,
        am.model_family,
        LAG(mph.intelligence_index_score, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mph.model_id
            ORDER BY mph.performance_date
        ) AS prev_intelligence_score,
        LEAD(mph.intelligence_index_score, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mph.model_id
            ORDER BY mph.performance_date
        ) AS next_intelligence_score,
        AVG(mph.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mph.model_id
            ORDER BY mph.performance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_intelligence_30d,
        STDDEV(mph.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mph.model_id
            ORDER BY mph.performance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS intelligence_volatility_30d
    FROM model_performance_history mph
    INNER JOIN ai_models am ON mph.model_id = am.model_id
    WHERE mph.performance_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
        AND am.model_status = 'active'
),
trajectory_calculation AS (
    SELECT
        pt.*,
        CASE
            WHEN pt.prev_intelligence_score IS NOT NULL THEN
                pt.intelligence_index_score - pt.prev_intelligence_score
            ELSE NULL
        END AS intelligence_change,
        CASE
            WHEN pt.prev_intelligence_score IS NOT NULL AND pt.prev_intelligence_score != 0 THEN
                ((pt.intelligence_index_score - pt.prev_intelligence_score) / pt.prev_intelligence_score) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS intelligence_change_percent,
        CASE
            WHEN (pt.intelligence_index_score - pt.prev_intelligence_score) > 0 THEN 'improving'
            WHEN (pt.intelligence_index_score - pt.prev_intelligence_score) < 0 THEN 'degrading'
            ELSE 'stable'
        END AS trajectory_direction,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY pt.model_id
            ORDER BY pt.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 89 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS evaluation_count_90d
    FROM performance_timeline pt
),
temporal_clustering AS (
    SELECT
        tc.*,
        AVG(tc.intelligence_change_percent) OVER (
            PARTITION BY tc.model_id, tc.trajectory_direction
            ORDER BY tc.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cluster_avg_change_7d,
        (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tc2.intelligence_change_percent)
         FROM trajectory_calculation tc2
         WHERE tc2.model_id = tc.model_id AND tc2.trajectory_direction = tc.trajectory_direction) AS cluster_median_change
    FROM trajectory_calculation tc
),
lifecycle_stage_detection AS (
    SELECT
        tcl.*,
        CASE
            WHEN tcl.evaluation_count_90d < 10 THEN 'early_stage'
            WHEN tcl.moving_avg_intelligence_30d < 50 THEN 'development'
            WHEN tcl.moving_avg_intelligence_30d >= 50 AND tcl.moving_avg_intelligence_30d < 75 THEN 'mature'
            WHEN tcl.moving_avg_intelligence_30d >= 75 THEN 'advanced'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END AS lifecycle_stage,
        CASE
            WHEN tcl.intelligence_volatility_30d < 2 THEN 'stable'
            WHEN tcl.intelligence_volatility_30d < 5 THEN 'moderate_volatility'
            ELSE 'high_volatility'
        END AS volatility_category
    FROM temporal_clustering tcl
),
trend_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        lsd.*,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN lsd.trajectory_direction = 'improving' THEN 1 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY lsd.model_id
            ORDER BY lsd.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS improving_count_30d,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN lsd.trajectory_direction = 'degrading' THEN 1 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY lsd.model_id
            ORDER BY lsd.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS degrading_count_30d
    FROM lifecycle_stage_detection lsd
),
final_trajectory_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        ta.*,
        CASE
            WHEN ta.improving_count_30d > ta.degrading_count_30d * 2 THEN 'strong_improvement'
            WHEN ta.improving_count_30d > ta.degrading_count_30d THEN 'improving'
            WHEN ta.degrading_count_30d > ta.improving_count_30d THEN 'degrading'
            ELSE 'stable'
        END AS overall_trend
    FROM trend_analysis ta
)
SELECT
    model_name,
    creator_company,
    model_family,
    evaluation_date,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_index_score AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_index_score,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_avg_intelligence_30d AS NUMERIC), 4) AS moving_avg_intelligence_30d,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_change_percent AS NUMERIC), 2) AS intelligence_change_percent,
    trajectory_direction,
    overall_trend,
    lifecycle_stage,
    volatility_category,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_volatility_30d AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_volatility_30d,
    improving_count_30d,
    degrading_count_30d,
    output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
    latency_seconds
FROM final_trajectory_analysis
WHERE evaluation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
ORDER BY model_id, evaluation_date DESC;

db-13.sql:
WITH base_data_22 AS (
    SELECT
        am.model_id,
        am.model_name,
        am.creator_company,
        am.model_family,
        mpm.intelligence_index_score,
        mpm.output_speed_tokens_per_sec,
        mpm.evaluation_date
    FROM ai_models am
    INNER JOIN model_performance_metrics mpm ON am.model_id = mpm.model_id
    WHERE mpm.evaluation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
        AND am.model_status = 'active'
),
aggregated_metrics_22 AS (
    SELECT
        bd.*,
        AVG(bd.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY bd.model_family
            ORDER BY bd.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS family_avg_intelligence_30d,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY bd.evaluation_date
            ORDER BY bd.intelligence_index_score DESC
        ) AS intelligence_rank,
        md.median_intelligence
    FROM base_data_22 bd
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT evaluation_date, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY intelligence_index_score) AS median_intelligence FROM base_data_22 GROUP BY evaluation_date) md ON bd.evaluation_date = md.evaluation_date
),
window_analysis_22 AS (
    SELECT
        am.*,
        LAG(am.intelligence_index_score, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY am.model_id
            ORDER BY am.evaluation_date
        ) AS prev_intelligence,
        LEAD(am.intelligence_index_score, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY am.model_id
            ORDER BY am.evaluation_date
        ) AS next_intelligence,
        STDDEV(am.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY am.model_id
            ORDER BY am.evaluation_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 89 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS intelligence_volatility_90d
    FROM aggregated_metrics_22 am
),
correlation_analysis_22 AS (
    SELECT
        wa.*,
        CASE
            WHEN wa.prev_intelligence IS NOT NULL THEN
                wa.intelligence_index_score - wa.prev_intelligence
            ELSE NULL
        END AS intelligence_change,
        CASE
            WHEN wa.intelligence_rank <= 10 THEN 'top_tier'
            WHEN wa.intelligence_rank <= 25 THEN 'high_tier'
            WHEN wa.intelligence_rank <= 50 THEN 'mid_tier'
            ELSE 'lower_tier'
        END AS performance_tier
    FROM window_analysis_22 wa
),
final_aggregation_22 AS (
    SELECT
        ca.*,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.model_family, ca.performance_tier
        ) AS tier_count_by_family,
        AVG(ca.intelligence_index_score) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.performance_tier
        ) AS tier_avg_intelligence
    FROM correlation_analysis_22 ca
)
SELECT
    model_name,
    creator_company,
    model_family,
    evaluation_date,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_index_score AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_index_score,
    ROUND(CAST(family_avg_intelligence_30d AS NUMERIC), 4) AS family_avg_intelligence_30d,
    intelligence_rank,
    ROUND(CAST(median_intelligence AS NUMERIC), 4) AS median_intelligence,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_change AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_change,
    performance_tier,
    ROUND(CAST(intelligence_volatility_90d AS NUMERIC), 4) AS intelligence_volatility_90d,
    tier_count_by_family,
    ROUND(CAST(tier_avg_intelligence AS NUMERIC), 4) AS tier_avg_intelligence,
    output_speed_tokens_per_sec
FROM final_aggregation_22
WHERE evaluation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days'
ORDER BY model_id, evaluation_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

db-14.title: Multi-Provider Cost-Performance Analysis with Recursive Instance Matching and Cross-Cloud Optimization Recommendations
db-14.description: Use Case: Cloud Cost Optimization - Cross-Cloud Instance Right-Sizing Analysis for Enterprise Migration Planning Description: Enterprise-level multi-provider cost-performance analysis using recursive CTE for instance matching across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with complex aggregations, window functions, percentile calculations, and cross-cloud optimization recommendations. Demonstrates production patterns used by cloud cost optimization platforms. Business Value: Comprehensive cost-performance compari
db-14.complexity: Recursive CTE for instance matching, 8+ nested CTEs, complex aggregations, window functions with multiple frame clauses, percentile calculations, cross-provider comparisons, cost optimization algorithms
db-14.expected_output: Report showing matched instances across providers with cost savings, performance metrics, and optimization recommendations
db-14.sql:
WITH provider_instance_base AS (
    -- First CTE: Base instance data with normalized specifications
    SELECT
        ci.instance_id,
        ci.provider_id,
        cp.provider_name,
        ci.instance_name,
        ci.api_name,
        ci.vcpus,
        ci.memory_gb,
        ci.instance_storage_gb,
        ci.instance_storage_type,
        ci.network_performance,
        ci.network_bandwidth_gbps,
        ci.architecture,
        ci.processor_type,
        ci.is_current_generation,
        cr.region_code,
        cr.region_name,
        cr.country_code,
        ifam.family_name AS instance_family,
        -- Normalize memory to GB for comparison
        CASE
            WHEN ci.memory_gb IS NULL AND ci.memory_mb IS NOT NULL THEN ci.memory_mb / 1024.0
            ELSE ci.memory_gb
        END AS normalized_memory_gb,
        -- Calculate vCPU-to-memory ratio
        CASE
            WHEN ci.vcpus > 0 AND ci.memory_gb IS NOT NULL THEN ci.memory_gb / ci.vcpus
            WHEN ci.vcpus > 0 AND ci.memory_mb IS NOT NULL THEN (ci.memory_mb / 1024.0) / ci.vcpus
            ELSE NULL
        END AS memory_per_vcpu_ratio
    FROM cloud_instances ci
    INNER JOIN cloud_providers cp ON ci.provider_id = cp.provider_id
    INNER JOIN cloud_regions cr ON ci.region_id = cr.region_id
    LEFT JOIN instance_families ifam ON ci.instance_family_id = ifam.family_id
    WHERE ci.is_available = TRUE
        AND ci.is_current_generation = TRUE
),
instance_performance_scores AS (
    -- Second CTE: Aggregate performance metrics with weighted scoring
    SELECT
        pib.instance_id,
        pib.provider_id,
        pib.provider_name,
        pib.instance_name,
        pib.vcpus,
        pib.normalized_memory_gb,
        pib.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        pib.instance_family,
        pib.region_code,
        -- CoreMark score (primary performance metric)
        MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'CoreMark' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END) AS coremark_score,
        -- FFmpeg FPS score (video processing performance)
        MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'FFmpeg FPS' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END) AS ffmpeg_fps_score,
        -- Calculate composite performance score
        (
            COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'CoreMark' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.6 +
            COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'FFmpeg FPS' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.4
        ) AS composite_performance_score,
        -- Performance per vCPU
        CASE
            WHEN pib.vcpus > 0 THEN
                (
                    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'CoreMark' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.6 +
                    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'FFmpeg FPS' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.4
                ) / pib.vcpus
            ELSE NULL
        END AS performance_per_vcpu,
        -- Performance per GB memory
        CASE
            WHEN pib.normalized_memory_gb > 0 THEN
                (
                    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'CoreMark' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.6 +
                    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ipm.benchmark_name = 'FFmpeg FPS' THEN ipm.benchmark_score_normalized END), 0) * 0.4
                ) / pib.normalized_memory_gb
            ELSE NULL
        END AS performance_per_gb_memory
    FROM provider_instance_base pib
    LEFT JOIN instance_performance_metrics ipm ON pib.instance_id = ipm.instance_id
    GROUP BY
        pib.instance_id,
        pib.provider_id,
        pib.provider_name,
        pib.instance_name,
        pib.vcpus,
        pib.normalized_memory_gb,
        pib.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        pib.instance_family,
        pib.region_code
),
instance_pricing_aggregated AS (
    -- Third CTE: Aggregate pricing across all pricing models
    SELECT
        ips.instance_id,
        ips.provider_id,
        ips.provider_name,
        ips.instance_name,
        ips.vcpus,
        ips.normalized_memory_gb,
        ips.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        ips.instance_family,
        ips.region_code,
        ips.coremark_score,
        ips.ffmpeg_fps_score,
        ips.composite_performance_score,
        ips.performance_per_vcpu,
        ips.performance_per_gb_memory,
        -- On-demand pricing
        MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'on_demand' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) AS on_demand_price_per_hour,
        -- Reserved 1-year pricing
        MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'reserved_1yr' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.payment_option = 'no_upfront' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.effective_hourly_cost END) AS reserved_1yr_price_per_hour,
        -- Reserved 3-year pricing
        MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'reserved_3yr' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.payment_option = 'no_upfront' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.effective_hourly_cost END) AS reserved_3yr_price_per_hour,
        -- Spot pricing (minimum)
        MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'spot' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) AS spot_min_price_per_hour,
        -- Calculate cost per vCPU (on-demand)
        CASE
            WHEN ips.vcpus > 0 AND MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'on_demand' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) IS NOT NULL THEN
                MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'on_demand' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) / ips.vcpus
            ELSE NULL
        END AS cost_per_vcpu_on_demand,
        -- Calculate cost per GB memory (on-demand)
        CASE
            WHEN ips.normalized_memory_gb > 0 AND MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'on_demand' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) IS NOT NULL THEN
                MIN(CASE WHEN ip.pricing_model = 'on_demand' AND ip.operating_system = 'Linux' AND ip.is_current = TRUE THEN ip.price_per_hour END) / ips.normalized_memory_gb
            ELSE NULL
        END AS cost_per_gb_memory_on_demand
    FROM instance_performance_scores ips
    LEFT JOIN instance_pricing ip ON ips.instance_id = ip.instance_id
    GROUP BY
        ips.instance_id,
        ips.provider_id,
        ips.provider_name,
        ips.instance_name,
        ips.vcpus,
        ips.normalized_memory_gb,
        ips.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        ips.instance_family,
        ips.region_code,
        ips.coremark_score,
        ips.ffmpeg_fps_score,
        ips.composite_performance_score,
        ips.performance_per_vcpu,
        ips.performance_per_gb_memory
),
cost_performance_ratios AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate cost-performance ratios
    SELECT
        ipa.instance_id,
        ipa.provider_id,
        ipa.provider_name,
        ipa.instance_name,
        ipa.vcpus,
        ipa.normalized_memory_gb,
        ipa.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        ipa.instance_family,
        ipa.region_code,
        ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour,
        ipa.reserved_1yr_price_per_hour,
        ipa.reserved_3yr_price_per_hour,
        ipa.spot_min_price_per_hour,
        ipa.composite_performance_score,
        ipa.performance_per_vcpu,
        ipa.performance_per_gb_memory,
        ipa.cost_per_vcpu_on_demand,
        ipa.cost_per_gb_memory_on_demand,
        -- Cost-performance ratio (lower is better)
        CASE
            WHEN ipa.composite_performance_score > 0 AND ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour IS NOT NULL THEN
                ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour / ipa.composite_performance_score
            ELSE NULL
        END AS cost_performance_ratio_on_demand,
        -- Performance per dollar (higher is better)
        CASE
            WHEN ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour > 0 AND ipa.composite_performance_score IS NOT NULL THEN
                ipa.composite_performance_score / ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour
            ELSE NULL
        END AS performance_per_dollar_on_demand,
        -- Reserved instance savings percentage
        CASE
            WHEN ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour > 0 AND ipa.reserved_1yr_price_per_hour IS NOT NULL THEN
                ((ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour - ipa.reserved_1yr_price_per_hour) / ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS reserved_1yr_savings_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour > 0 AND ipa.reserved_3yr_price_per_hour IS NOT NULL THEN
                ((ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour - ipa.reserved_3yr_price_per_hour) / ipa.on_demand_price_per_hour) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS reserved_3yr_savings_pct
    FROM instance_pricing_aggregated ipa
),
instance_specification_clusters AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Cluster instances by specification similarity using window functions
    SELECT
        cpr.instance_id,
        cpr.provider_id,
        cpr.provider_name,
        cpr.instance_name,
        cpr.vcpus,
        cpr.normalized_memory_gb,
        cpr.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
        cpr.instance_family,
        cpr.region_code,
        cpr.on_demand_price_per_hour,
        cpr.reserved_1yr_price_per_hour,
        cpr.reserved_3yr_price_per_hour,
        cpr.spot_min_price_per_hour,
        cpr.composite_performance_score,
        cpr.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand,
        cpr.performance_per_dollar_on_demand,
        cpr.reserved_1yr_savings_pct,
        cpr.reserved_3yr_savings_pct,
        -- Find similar instances using window functions
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                CASE WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' ELSE '32+' END,
                CASE WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 32 AND 64 THEN '32-64' ELSE '64+' END
        ) AS similar_spec_count,
        -- Rank by cost-performance ratio within specification cluster
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                CASE WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' ELSE '32+' END,
                CASE WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 32 AND 64 THEN '32-64' ELSE '64+' END
            ORDER BY cpr.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS cost_performance_rank,
        -- Rank by performance per dollar
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                CASE WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.vcpus BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' ELSE '32+' END,
                CASE WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 4 AND 8 THEN '4-8' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 8 AND 16 THEN '8-16' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 16 AND 32 THEN '16-32' WHEN cpr.normalized_memory_gb BETWEEN 32 AND 64 THEN '32-64' ELSE '64+' END
            ORDER BY cpr.performance_per_dollar_on_demand DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS performance_per_dollar_rank
    FROM cost_performance_ratios cpr
    WHERE cpr.on_demand_price_per_hour IS NOT NULL
        AND cpr.composite_performance_score IS NOT NULL
),
recursive_instance_matching AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Recursive CTE for finding best matching instances across providers
    WITH RECURSIVE instance_match_tree AS (
        -- Anchor: Start with AWS instances as base
        SELECT
            isc.instance_id,
            isc.provider_id,
            isc.provider_name,
            isc.instance_name,
            isc.vcpus,
            isc.normalized_memory_gb,
            isc.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
            isc.on_demand_price_per_hour,
            isc.composite_performance_score,
            isc.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand,
            isc.performance_per_dollar_on_demand,
            1 AS match_level,
            CAST(isc.instance_id AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS match_path,
            isc.instance_id AS base_instance_id
        FROM instance_specification_clusters isc
        WHERE isc.provider_id = 'aws'
            AND isc.cost_performance_rank = 1
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Recursive: Find matching instances in other providers
        SELECT
            isc.instance_id,
            isc.provider_id,
            isc.provider_name,
            isc.instance_name,
            isc.vcpus,
            isc.normalized_memory_gb,
            isc.memory_per_vcpu_ratio,
            isc.on_demand_price_per_hour,
            isc.composite_performance_score,
            isc.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand,
            isc.performance_per_dollar_on_demand,
            imt.match_level + 1,
            CAST(imt.match_path || ' -> ' || isc.instance_id AS VARCHAR(1000)),
            imt.base_instance_id
        FROM instance_match_tree imt
        INNER JOIN instance_specification_clusters isc ON (
            -- Match instances with similar specifications (within 10% tolerance)
            ABS(isc.vcpus - imt.vcpus) <= GREATEST(imt.vcpus * 0.1, 1)
            AND ABS(isc.normalized_memory_gb - imt.normalized_memory_gb) <= GREATEST(imt.normalized_memory_gb * 0.1, 1)
            AND isc.provider_id != imt.provider_id
            AND imt.match_level < 3  -- Limit recursion depth
        )
    )
    SELECT * FROM instance_match_tree
),
cross_provider_optimization AS (
    -- Seventh CTE: Calculate optimization opportunities across providers
    SELECT
        rim.base_instance_id,
        rim.instance_id,
        rim.provider_id,
        rim.provider_name,
        rim.instance_name,
        rim.vcpus,
        rim.normalized_memory_gb,
        rim.on_demand_price_per_hour,
        rim.composite_performance_score,
        rim.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand,
        rim.performance_per_dollar_on_demand,
        rim.match_level,
        rim.match_path,
        -- Compare with base instance
        base.on_demand_price_per_hour AS base_price_per_hour,
        base.composite_performance_score AS base_performance_score,
        base.cost_performance_ratio_on_demand AS base_cost_performance_ratio,
        -- Calculate cost difference
        rim.on_demand_price_per_hour - base.on_demand_price_per_hour AS price_difference,
        CASE
            WHEN base.on_demand_price_per_hour > 0 THEN
                ((rim.on_demand_price_per_hour - base.on_demand_price_per_hour) / base.on_demand_price_per_hour) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS price_difference_pct,
        -- Performance difference
        rim.composite_performance_score - base.composite_performance_score AS performance_difference,
        CASE
            WHEN base.composite_performance_score > 0 THEN
                ((rim.composite_performance_score - base.composite_performance_score) / base.composite_performance_score) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS performance_difference_pct,
        -- Cost savings potential (monthly)
        CASE
            WHEN rim.on_demand_price_per_hour < base.on_demand_price_per_hour THEN
                (base.on_demand_price_per_hour - rim.on_demand_price_per_hour) * 24 * 30
            ELSE 0
        END AS monthly_cost_savings
    FROM recursive_instance_matching rim
    INNER JOIN recursive_instance_matching base ON rim.base_instance_id = base.instance_id AND base.match_level = 1
),
final_optimization_recommendations AS (
    -- Eighth CTE: Generate final recommendations with ranking
    SELECT
        cpo.base_instance_id,
        cpo.instance_id AS recommended_instance_id,
        cpo.provider_id AS recommended_provider_id,
        cpo.provider_name AS recommended_provider_name,
        cpo.instance_name AS recommended_instance_name,
        cpo.vcpus,
        cpo.normalized_memory_gb,
        cpo.on_demand_price_per_hour AS recommended_price_per_hour,
        cpo.composite_performance_score AS recommended_performance_score,
        cpo.base_price_per_hour,
        cpo.base_performance_score,
        cpo.price_difference,
        cpo.price_difference_pct,
        cpo.performance_difference,
        cpo.performance_difference_pct,
        cpo.monthly_cost_savings,
        -- Calculate optimization score (weighted)
        (
            CASE WHEN cpo.monthly_cost_savings > 0 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN cpo.performance_difference >= 0 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END +
            CASE WHEN ABS(cpo.price_difference_pct) <= 20 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS optimization_score,
        -- Rank recommendations
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cpo.base_instance_id
            ORDER BY
                cpo.monthly_cost_savings DESC,
                cpo.performance_difference DESC,
                ABS(cpo.price_difference_pct) ASC
        ) AS recommendation_rank
    FROM cross_provider_optimization cpo
    WHERE cpo.monthly_cost_savings > 0 OR cpo.performance_difference > 0
)
SELECT
    base.instance_name AS base_instance,
    base.provider_name AS base_provider,
    base.vcpus AS base_vcpus,
    base.normalized_memory_gb AS base_memory_gb,
    base.on_demand_price_per_hour AS base_price_per_hour,
    base.composite_performance_score AS base_performance_score,
    for_rec.recommended_instance_name AS recommended_instance,
    for_rec.recommended_provider_name AS recommended_provider,
    for_rec.recommended_price_per_hour AS recommended_price_per_hour,
    for_rec.recommended_performance_score AS recommended_performance_score,
    for_rec.price_difference,
    ROUND(CAST(for_rec.price_difference_pct AS NUMERIC), 2) AS price_difference_pct,
    for_rec.performance_difference,
    ROUND(CAST(for_rec.performance_difference_pct AS NUMERIC), 2) AS performance_difference_pct,
    ROUND(CAST(for_rec.monthly_cost_savings AS NUMERIC), 2) AS monthly_cost_savings,
    for_rec.optimization_score,
    for_rec.recommendation_rank
FROM final_optimization_recommendations for_rec
INNER JOIN instance_specification_clusters base ON for_rec.base_instance_id = base.instance_id
WHERE for_rec.recommendation_rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    for_rec.base_instance_id,
    for_rec.recommendation_rank;

db-14.title: Historical Pricing Trend Analysis with Recursive CTE and Multi-Period Forecasting
db-14.description: Use Case: Cloud Cost Forecasting - Historical Pricing Trend Analysis with Recursive CTE and Multi-Period Forecasting Description: Enterprise-level historical pricing trend analysis with recursive cte and multi-period forecasting with Recursive CTE for time-series analysis, 8+ nested CTEs. Demonstrates production patterns for cloud cost . Business Value: Historical Pricing Trend Analysis with Recursive CTE and Multi-Period Forecasting report showing cost  metrics and recommendations. Purpose: Pro
db-14.complexity: Recursive CTE for time-series analysis, 8+ nested CTEs, window functions with multiple frame clauses, complex aggregations, percentile calculations
db-14.expected_output: Query results with detailed cost  metrics
db-14.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE pricing_time_series AS (
    -- Anchor: Base pricing data
    SELECT
        hp.instance_id,
        hp.region_id,
        hp.pricing_model,
        hp.effective_date,
        hp.price_per_hour,
        1 AS period_level,
        CAST(hp.instance_id AS VARCHAR(1000)) AS price_path
    FROM historical_pricing hp
    WHERE hp.effective_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: Build time series with period progression
    SELECT
        hp.instance_id,
        hp.region_id,
        hp.pricing_model,
        hp.effective_date,
        hp.price_per_hour,
        pts.period_level + 1,
        CAST(pts.price_path || ' -> ' || hp.instance_id AS VARCHAR(1000))
    FROM pricing_time_series pts
    INNER JOIN historical_pricing hp ON (
        pts.instance_id = hp.instance_id
        AND pts.region_id = hp.region_id
        AND pts.pricing_model = hp.pricing_model
        AND hp.effective_date > pts.effective_date
        AND pts.period_level < 24  -- Limit to 24 months
    )
),
base_instance_data AS (
    SELECT
        ci.instance_id,
        ci.provider_id,
        ci.instance_name,
        ci.vcpus,
        ci.memory_gb,
        cr.region_code,
        cr.region_name
    FROM cloud_instances ci
    INNER JOIN cloud_regions cr ON ci.region_id = cr.region_id
    WHERE ci.is_available = TRUE
),
pricing_aggregations AS (
    SELECT
        pts.instance_id,
        pts.region_id,
        pts.pricing_model,
        COUNT(*) AS price_points_count,
        MIN(pts.price_per_hour) AS min_price,
        MAX(pts.price_per_hour) AS max_price,
        AVG(pts.price_per_hour) AS avg_price,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pts.price_per_hour) AS median_price,
        STDDEV(pts.price_per_hour) AS price_volatility
    FROM pricing_time_series pts
    GROUP BY pts.instance_id, pts.region_id, pts.pricing_model
),
price_trend_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        pa.instance_id,
        pa.region_id,
        pa.pricing_model,
        pa.price_points_count,
        pa.min_price,
        pa.max_price,
        pa.avg_price,
        pa.median_price,
        pa.price_volatility,
        bid.provider_id,
        bid.instance_name,
        bid.vcpus,
        bid.memory_gb,
        bid.region_code,
        bid.region_name,
        -- Calculate price change trend
        CASE
            WHEN pa.price_volatility > 0 THEN
                (pa.max_price - pa.min_price) / pa.avg_price * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS price_volatility_pct
    FROM pricing_aggregations pa
    INNER JOIN base_instance_data bid ON pa.instance_id = bid.instance_id
),
trend_classification AS (
    SELECT
        pta.*,
        CASE
            WHEN pta.price_volatility_pct < 5 THEN 'Stable'
            WHEN pta.price_volatility_pct < 15 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN pta.price_volatility_pct < 30 THEN 'Volatile'
            ELSE 'Highly Volatile'
        END AS volatility_classification,
        -- Window functions for trend analysis
        AVG(pta.avg_price) OVER (
            PARTITION BY pta.provider_id, pta.pricing_model
        ) AS provider_avg_price,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pta.provider_id, pta.pricing_model
            ORDER BY pta.price_volatility_pct DESC
        ) AS volatility_rank
    FROM price_trend_analysis pta
),
forecast_preparation AS (
    SELECT
        tc.*,
        -- Calculate forecast inputs
        tc.avg_price * 1.02 AS forecast_price_next_month,
        tc.avg_price * 1.05 AS forecast_price_next_quarter,
        tc.avg_price * 1.10 AS forecast_price_next_year,
        -- Price deviation from provider average
        CASE
            WHEN tc.provider_avg_price > 0 THEN
                ((tc.avg_price - tc.provider_avg_price) / tc.provider_avg_price) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS price_deviation_from_provider_avg_pct
    FROM trend_classification tc
),
final_forecast_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        fp.instance_id,
        fp.instance_name,
        fp.provider_id,
        fp.region_code,
        fp.region_name,
        fp.pricing_model,
        fp.price_points_count,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.avg_price AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_price,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.median_price AS NUMERIC), 6) AS median_price,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.price_volatility AS NUMERIC), 6) AS price_volatility,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.price_volatility_pct AS NUMERIC), 2) AS price_volatility_pct,
        fp.volatility_classification,
        fp.volatility_rank,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.forecast_price_next_month AS NUMERIC), 6) AS forecast_price_next_month,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.forecast_price_next_quarter AS NUMERIC), 6) AS forecast_price_next_quarter,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.forecast_price_next_year AS NUMERIC), 6) AS forecast_price_next_year,
        ROUND(CAST(fp.price_deviation_from_provider_avg_pct AS NUMERIC), 2) AS price_deviation_from_provider_avg_pct
    FROM forecast_preparation fp
)
SELECT * FROM final_forecast_analysis
ORDER BY final_forecast_analysis.volatility_rank, final_forecast_analysis.price_volatility_pct DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH RECURSIVE instance_dependency_tree AS (
    -- Anchor: Base instances

db-15.title: Multi-Level Electricity Rate Analysis with Geographic Aggregations and Rate Code Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level electricity rate analysis with multi-level CTE nesting, geographic aggregations, rate code classifications, utility comparisons, and advanced window functions. Demonstrates production patterns used by energy consulting firms and utility rate intelligence platforms. Use Case: Utility Rate Analysis Platform - Comprehensive Rate Analysis Dashboard for Energy Consultants Business Value: Comprehensive rate analysis report showing rates by state, utility, rate code, and g
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), geographic aggregations, complex joins across multiple tables, window functions with multiple frame clauses, percentile calculations, rate trend analysis, correlated subqueries
db-15.expected_output: Comprehensive rate analysis with geographic aggregations, rate code classifications, utility comparisons, and cost intelligence metrics.
db-15.sql:
WITH state_rate_summary AS (
    -- First CTE: Aggregate rates by state with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        s.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        s.division,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.utility_id) AS utility_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_code_id) AS rate_code_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rate_count,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS q1_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS q3_energy_charge,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_energy_charge,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_energy_charge,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS stddev_energy_charge,
        AVG(er.fixed_charge_usd) AS avg_fixed_charge,
        AVG(er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw) AS avg_demand_charge
    FROM states s
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON s.state_id = er.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name, s.region, s.division
),
utility_rate_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze rates by utility with rate code breakdown
    SELECT
        uc.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        uc.utility_type,
        uc.state_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_code_id) AS rate_codes_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rates,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_energy_charge,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_energy_charge,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_energy_charge,
        AVG(er.fixed_charge_usd) AS avg_fixed_charge,
        AVG(er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw) AS avg_demand_charge,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Residential' THEN er.rate_id END) AS residential_rate_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Commercial' THEN er.rate_id END) AS commercial_rate_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Industrial' THEN er.rate_id END) AS industrial_rate_count
    FROM utility_companies uc
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON uc.utility_id = er.utility_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
        AND uc.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY uc.utility_id, uc.utility_name, uc.utility_type, uc.state_id
),
rate_code_intelligence AS (
    -- Third CTE: Rate code analysis with structure type breakdown
    SELECT
        rc.rate_code_id,
        rc.rate_code,
        rc.rate_code_category,
        rc.sector,
        rc.rate_structure_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.utility_id) AS utilities_offering_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.state_id) AS states_with_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rates,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_energy_charge,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS stddev_energy_charge,
        AVG(er.fixed_charge_usd) AS avg_fixed_charge,
        AVG(er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw) AS avg_demand_charge
    FROM rate_codes rc
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rc.rate_code_id = er.rate_code_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
        AND rc.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY rc.rate_code_id, rc.rate_code, rc.rate_code_category, rc.sector, rc.rate_structure_type
),
geographic_rate_analysis AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Geographic rate analysis by zip code and county
    SELECT
        gra.rate_area_id,
        gra.state_id,
        gra.county_id,
        gra.zip_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gra.rate_structure_id) AS rate_structures_in_area,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rs.utility_id) AS utilities_in_area,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_area_energy_charge,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_area_energy_charge,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_area_energy_charge
    FROM geographic_rate_areas gra
    INNER JOIN rate_structures rs ON gra.rate_structure_id = rs.rate_structure_id
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rs.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
    WHERE gra.expiration_date IS NULL OR gra.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE
        AND er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY gra.rate_area_id, gra.state_id, gra.county_id, gra.zip_code
),
rate_comparison_metrics AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Rate comparison metrics with window functions
    SELECT
        er.rate_id,
        er.utility_id,
        er.state_id,
        er.rate_code_id,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        er.fixed_charge_usd,
        er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        -- Window functions for rate comparisons
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.state_id, er.rate_type
        ) AS state_avg_energy_charge,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.utility_id
        ) AS utility_avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.state_id
            ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        ) AS state_rate_percentile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.state_id, er.rate_type
            ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        ) AS state_rate_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.state_id
            ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        ) AS state_rate_quartile,
        LAG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.utility_id, er.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY er.effective_date
        ) AS prev_energy_charge,
        LEAD(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.utility_id, er.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY er.effective_date
        ) AS next_energy_charge
    FROM electricity_rates er
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
),
rate_trend_analysis AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Rate trend analysis with historical comparisons
    SELECT
        rcm.rate_id,
        rcm.utility_id,
        rcm.state_id,
        rcm.rate_code_id,
        rcm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        rcm.fixed_charge_usd,
        rcm.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        rcm.state_avg_energy_charge,
        rcm.utility_avg_energy_charge,
        rcm.state_rate_percentile,
        rcm.state_rate_rank,
        rcm.state_rate_quartile,
        rcm.prev_energy_charge,
        rcm.next_energy_charge,
        -- Rate change calculations
        CASE
            WHEN rcm.prev_energy_charge IS NOT NULL THEN
                rcm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - rcm.prev_energy_charge
            ELSE NULL
        END AS energy_charge_change,
        CASE
            WHEN rcm.prev_energy_charge IS NOT NULL AND rcm.prev_energy_charge != 0 THEN
                ((rcm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - rcm.prev_energy_charge) / ABS(rcm.prev_energy_charge)) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS energy_charge_change_percentage,
        -- Rate competitiveness metrics
        CASE
            WHEN rcm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh < rcm.state_avg_energy_charge THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN rcm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh = rcm.state_avg_energy_charge THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average'
        END AS competitiveness_classification,
        -- Historical rate comparison
        (
            SELECT AVG(her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh)
            FROM historical_electricity_rates her
            WHERE her.utility_id = rcm.utility_id
                AND her.rate_code_id = rcm.rate_code_id
                AND her.effective_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
        ) AS historical_12mo_avg
    FROM rate_comparison_metrics rcm
),
final_rate_intelligence AS (
    -- Seventh CTE: Final intelligence aggregation with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        rta.rate_id,
        rta.utility_id,
        rta.state_id,
        rta.rate_code_id,
        srs.state_name,
        srs.region,
        srs.division,
        ura.utility_name,
        ura.utility_type,
        rci.rate_code,
        rci.rate_code_category,
        rci.sector,
        rci.rate_structure_type,
        rta.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        rta.fixed_charge_usd,
        rta.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        rta.state_avg_energy_charge,
        rta.utility_avg_energy_charge,
        ROUND(CAST(rta.state_rate_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_rate_percentile,
        rta.state_rate_rank,
        rta.state_rate_quartile,
        ROUND(CAST(rta.energy_charge_change AS NUMERIC), 6) AS energy_charge_change,
        ROUND(CAST(rta.energy_charge_change_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS energy_charge_change_percentage,
        rta.competitiveness_classification,
        ROUND(CAST(rta.historical_12mo_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS historical_12mo_avg,
        srs.utility_count,
        srs.rate_code_count,
        srs.total_rate_count,
        ura.rate_codes_offered,
        ura.total_rates,
        rci.utilities_offering_code,
        rci.states_with_code
    FROM rate_trend_analysis rta
    INNER JOIN state_rate_summary srs ON rta.state_id = srs.state_id
    INNER JOIN utility_rate_analysis ura ON rta.utility_id = ura.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_code_intelligence rci ON rta.rate_code_id = rci.rate_code_id
)
SELECT
    rate_id,
    utility_id,
    utility_name,
    utility_type,
    state_id,
    state_name,
    region,
    division,
    rate_code_id,
    rate_code,
    rate_code_category,
    sector,
    rate_structure_type,
    energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
    fixed_charge_usd,
    demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
    state_avg_energy_charge,
    utility_avg_energy_charge,
    state_rate_percentile,
    state_rate_rank,
    state_rate_quartile,
    energy_charge_change,
    energy_charge_change_percentage,
    competitiveness_classification,
    historical_12mo_avg,
    utility_count,
    rate_code_count,
    total_rate_count,
    rate_codes_offered,
    total_rates,
    utilities_offering_code,
    states_with_code
FROM final_rate_intelligence
ORDER BY state_name, utility_name, rate_code, energy_charge_usd_per_kwh;

db-15.title: Recursive Rate Structure Analysis with Tiered Rate Calculations and Time-of-Use Optimization
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level recursive rate structure analysis using recursive CTE for tiered rate calculations, time-of-use period analysis, rate optimization scenarios, and multi-level rate structure traversal. Implements production patterns for analyzing complex rate structures with multiple tiers and TOU periods. Use Case: Energy Cost Optimization Platform - Tiered Rate and TOU Analysis for Commercial Energy Management Business Value: Comprehensive tiered rate and TOU analysis showing optim
db-15.complexity: Advanced recursive CTE with tier calculations, TOU period analysis, multi-level rate structure traversal, usage scenario modeling, cost optimization calculations, multiple CTE nesting levels (6+)
db-15.expected_output: Comprehensive tiered rate and TOU analysis with usage scenarios, cost calculations, and optimization recommendations.
db-15.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE tiered_rate_calculations AS (
    -- Anchor CTE: Base tier calculations for tiered rates
    SELECT
        trt.tier_id,
        trt.rate_structure_id,
        trt.tier_number,
        trt.tier_name,
        trt.tier_start_kwh,
        trt.tier_end_kwh,
        trt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        rs.utility_id,
        rs.rate_code_id,
        er.state_id,
        -- Calculate tier range
        CASE
            WHEN trt.tier_end_kwh IS NULL THEN 999999
            ELSE trt.tier_end_kwh - trt.tier_start_kwh
        END AS tier_kwh_range,
        -- Tier usage scenarios
        0 AS cumulative_kwh_usage,
        trt.tier_start_kwh AS scenario_start_kwh,
        COALESCE(trt.tier_end_kwh, 999999) AS scenario_end_kwh
    FROM tiered_rate_tiers trt
    INNER JOIN rate_structures rs ON trt.rate_structure_id = rs.rate_structure_id
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rs.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
    WHERE rs.is_current = TRUE
        AND er.is_current = TRUE
        AND trt.expiration_date IS NULL OR trt.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step: Calculate cumulative tier costs
    SELECT
        trc.tier_id,
        trc.rate_structure_id,
        trc.tier_number,
        trc.tier_name,
        trc.tier_start_kwh,
        trc.tier_end_kwh,
        trc.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        trc.utility_id,
        trc.rate_code_id,
        trc.state_id,
        trc.tier_kwh_range,
        trc.cumulative_kwh_usage + trc.tier_kwh_range,
        trc.scenario_start_kwh,
        trc.scenario_end_kwh
    FROM tiered_rate_calculations trc
    INNER JOIN tiered_rate_tiers trt ON (
        trt.rate_structure_id = trc.rate_structure_id
        AND trt.tier_number = trc.tier_number + 1
    )
    WHERE trc.cumulative_kwh_usage < 10000
),
tou_period_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Time-of-use period analysis with period aggregations
    SELECT
        tou.tou_period_id,
        tou.rate_structure_id,
        tou.period_name,
        tou.period_start_time,
        tou.period_end_time,
        tou.day_of_week,
        tou.season,
        tou.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        rs.utility_id,
        rs.rate_code_id,
        er.state_id,
        -- Calculate period duration in hours
        CASE
            WHEN tou.period_end_time > tou.period_start_time THEN
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tou.period_end_time - tou.period_start_time)) / 3600
            ELSE
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tou.period_end_time + INTERVAL '24 hours' - tou.period_start_time)) / 3600
        END AS period_duration_hours,
        -- Period cost scenarios
        CASE
            WHEN tou.period_name LIKE '%Peak%' THEN 'High Cost'
            WHEN tou.period_name LIKE '%Off-Peak%' THEN 'Low Cost'
            ELSE 'Medium Cost'
        END AS period_cost_category
    FROM time_of_use_periods tou
    INNER JOIN rate_structures rs ON tou.rate_structure_id = rs.rate_structure_id
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rs.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
    WHERE rs.is_current = TRUE
        AND er.is_current = TRUE
        AND tou.expiration_date IS NULL OR tou.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE
),
usage_scenario_modeling AS (
    -- Third CTE: Model usage scenarios for cost calculations
    SELECT
        usage_kwh,
        usage_scenario_name
    FROM (
        VALUES
            (500, 'Low Usage'),
            (1000, 'Medium Usage'),
            (2000, 'High Usage'),
            (5000, 'Very High Usage')
    ) AS scenarios(usage_kwh, usage_scenario_name)
),
tiered_rate_cost_calculations AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate costs for tiered rates across usage scenarios
    SELECT
        trc.rate_structure_id,
        trc.utility_id,
        trc.rate_code_id,
        trc.state_id,
        usm.usage_kwh,
        usm.usage_scenario_name,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN usm.usage_kwh >= trc.tier_start_kwh THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN trc.tier_end_kwh IS NULL OR usm.usage_kwh <= trc.tier_end_kwh THEN
                            (usm.usage_kwh - trc.tier_start_kwh + 1) * trc.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                        ELSE
                            trc.tier_kwh_range * trc.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS tiered_energy_cost,
        MAX(trc.tier_number) AS tiers_applied,
        COUNT(DISTINCT trc.tier_id) AS tier_count
    FROM tiered_rate_calculations trc
    CROSS JOIN usage_scenario_modeling usm
    GROUP BY trc.rate_structure_id, trc.utility_id, trc.rate_code_id, trc.state_id, usm.usage_kwh, usm.usage_scenario_name
),
tou_rate_cost_calculations AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Calculate costs for TOU rates across usage scenarios
    SELECT
        toua.rate_structure_id,
        toua.utility_id,
        toua.rate_code_id,
        toua.state_id,
        usm.usage_kwh,
        usm.usage_scenario_name,
        -- Distribute usage across TOU periods (simplified: 40% peak, 60% off-peak)
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN toua.period_cost_category = 'High Cost' THEN
                    usm.usage_kwh * 0.4 * toua.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                WHEN toua.period_cost_category = 'Low Cost' THEN
                    usm.usage_kwh * 0.6 * toua.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                ELSE
                    usm.usage_kwh * 0.1 * toua.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
            END
        ) AS tou_energy_cost,
        COUNT(DISTINCT toua.tou_period_id) AS tou_period_count,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN toua.period_cost_category = 'High Cost' THEN toua.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS avg_peak_rate,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN toua.period_cost_category = 'Low Cost' THEN toua.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS avg_offpeak_rate
    FROM tou_period_analysis toua
    CROSS JOIN usage_scenario_modeling usm
    GROUP BY toua.rate_structure_id, toua.utility_id, toua.rate_code_id, toua.state_id, usm.usage_kwh, usm.usage_scenario_name
),
rate_optimization_comparison AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Compare tiered vs TOU rates for optimization
    SELECT
        COALESCE(trcc.rate_structure_id, torcc.rate_structure_id) AS rate_structure_id,
        COALESCE(trcc.utility_id, torcc.utility_id) AS utility_id,
        COALESCE(trcc.rate_code_id, torcc.rate_code_id) AS rate_code_id,
        COALESCE(trcc.state_id, torcc.state_id) AS state_id,
        COALESCE(trcc.usage_kwh, torcc.usage_kwh) AS usage_kwh,
        COALESCE(trcc.usage_scenario_name, torcc.usage_scenario_name) AS usage_scenario_name,
        trcc.tiered_energy_cost,
        trcc.tiers_applied,
        trcc.tier_count,
        torcc.tou_energy_cost,
        torcc.tou_period_count,
        torcc.avg_peak_rate,
        torcc.avg_offpeak_rate,
        -- Cost comparison
        CASE
            WHEN trcc.tiered_energy_cost IS NOT NULL AND torcc.tou_energy_cost IS NOT NULL THEN
                trcc.tiered_energy_cost - torcc.tou_energy_cost
            ELSE NULL
        END AS cost_difference_tiered_vs_tou,
        CASE
            WHEN trcc.tiered_energy_cost IS NOT NULL AND torcc.tou_energy_cost IS NOT NULL AND torcc.tou_energy_cost != 0 THEN
                ((trcc.tiered_energy_cost - torcc.tou_energy_cost) / ABS(torcc.tou_energy_cost)) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS cost_difference_percentage,
        -- Optimal rate recommendation
        CASE
            WHEN trcc.tiered_energy_cost IS NOT NULL AND torcc.tou_energy_cost IS NOT NULL THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN trcc.tiered_energy_cost < torcc.tou_energy_cost THEN 'Tiered Rate'
                    ELSE 'TOU Rate'
                END
            WHEN trcc.tiered_energy_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'Tiered Rate'
            WHEN torcc.tou_energy_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'TOU Rate'
            ELSE 'Standard Rate'
        END AS optimal_rate_type
    FROM tiered_rate_cost_calculations trcc
    FULL OUTER JOIN tou_rate_cost_calculations torcc ON (
        trcc.rate_structure_id = torcc.rate_structure_id
        AND trcc.usage_kwh = torcc.usage_kwh
    )
)
SELECT
    roc.rate_structure_id,
    roc.utility_id,
    uc.utility_name,
    roc.rate_code_id,
    rc.rate_code,
    rc.rate_code_category,
    roc.state_id,
    s.state_name,
    roc.usage_kwh,
    roc.usage_scenario_name,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.tiered_energy_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS tiered_energy_cost,
    roc.tiers_applied,
    roc.tier_count,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.tou_energy_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS tou_energy_cost,
    roc.tou_period_count,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.avg_peak_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_peak_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.avg_offpeak_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_offpeak_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.cost_difference_tiered_vs_tou AS NUMERIC), 2) AS cost_difference_tiered_vs_tou,
    ROUND(CAST(roc.cost_difference_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS cost_difference_percentage,
    roc.optimal_rate_type
FROM rate_optimization_comparison roc
INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON roc.utility_id = uc.utility_id
INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON roc.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
INNER JOIN states s ON roc.state_id = s.state_id
ORDER BY roc.state_id, roc.utility_id, roc.usage_kwh;

db-15.sql:
WITH federal_incentive_analysis AS (
    -- First CTE: Analyze federal incentives with eligibility matching
    SELECT
        fi.federal_incentive_id,
        fi.incentive_name,
        fi.incentive_type,
        fi.incentive_amount_usd,
        fi.incentive_percentage,
        fi.incentive_unit,
        fi.maximum_incentive_usd,
        fi.minimum_system_size_kw,
        fi.maximum_system_size_kw,
        fi.effective_date,
        fi.expiration_date,
        fi.eligible_technologies,
        fi.eligible_sectors,
        -- Calculate incentive value for different system sizes
        CASE
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'percentage' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN fi.incentive_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN fi.maximum_incentive_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                                LEAST(
                                    (10000 * fi.incentive_percentage / 100),
                                    fi.maximum_incentive_usd
                                )
                            ELSE (10000 * fi.incentive_percentage / 100)
                        END
                    ELSE fi.incentive_amount_usd
                END
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'per_watt' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN fi.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                        (10000 * fi.incentive_amount_usd / 1000)
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN fi.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE fi.incentive_amount_usd
        END AS estimated_incentive_value_10kw,
        CASE
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'percentage' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN fi.incentive_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN fi.maximum_incentive_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                                LEAST(
                                    (5000 * fi.incentive_percentage / 100),
                                    fi.maximum_incentive_usd
                                )
                            ELSE (5000 * fi.incentive_percentage / 100)
                        END
                    ELSE fi.incentive_amount_usd
                END
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'per_watt' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN fi.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                        (5000 * fi.incentive_amount_usd / 1000)
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN fi.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN fi.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE fi.incentive_amount_usd
        END AS estimated_incentive_value_5kw
    FROM federal_incentives fi
    WHERE fi.is_active = TRUE
        AND (fi.expiration_date IS NULL OR fi.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE)
        AND 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(fi.eligible_technologies)
),
state_incentive_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze state incentives with geographic matching
    SELECT
        si.state_incentive_id,

        -- Calculate incentive value for different system sizes
        CASE
            WHEN si.incentive_unit = 'percentage' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN si.incentive_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN si.maximum_incentive_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                                LEAST(
                                    (10000 * si.incentive_percentage / 100),
                                    si.maximum_incentive_usd
                                )
                            ELSE (10000 * si.incentive_percentage / 100)
                        END
                    ELSE si.incentive_amount_usd
                END
            WHEN si.incentive_unit = 'per_watt' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN si.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                        (10000 * si.incentive_amount_usd / 1000)
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN si.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN si.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE si.incentive_amount_usd
        END AS estimated_incentive_value_10kw,
        CASE
            WHEN si.incentive_unit = 'percentage' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN si.incentive_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN si.maximum_incentive_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                                LEAST(

                CASE
                    WHEN si.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN

                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN si.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN si.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE si.incentive_amount_usd

    FROM state_incentives si
    INNER JOIN states s ON si.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE si.is_active = TRUE
        AND (si.expiration_date IS NULL OR si.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE)
        AND 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(si.eligible_technologies)
),
utility_incentive_analysis AS (
    -- Third CTE: Analyze utility incentives with utility matching
    SELECT
        ui.utility_incentive_id,
        ui.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        ui.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        ui.incentive_name,
        ui.incentive_type,

        -- Calculate incentive value for different system sizes

                        CASE

                                LEAST(
                                    (10000 * ui.incentive_percentage / 100),
                                    ui.maximum_incentive_usd
                                )
                            ELSE (10000 * ui.incentive_percentage / 100)
                        END
                    ELSE ui.incentive_amount_usd
                END
            WHEN ui.incentive_unit = 'per_watt' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ui.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                        (10000 * ui.incentive_amount_usd / 1000)
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN ui.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN ui.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE ui.incentive_amount_usd
        END AS estimated_incentive_value_10kw,
        CASE
            WHEN ui.incentive_unit = 'percentage' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ui.incentive_percentage IS NOT NULL THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN ui.maximum_incentive_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                                LEAST(
                                    (5000 * ui.incentive_percentage / 100),

                END
            WHEN ui.incentive_unit = 'per_watt' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN ui.incentive_amount_usd IS NOT NULL THEN
                        (5000 * ui.incentive_amount_usd / 1000)
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHEN ui.incentive_unit = 'fixed_amount' THEN ui.incentive_amount_usd
            ELSE ui.incentive_amount_usd
        END AS estimated_incentive_value_5kw
    FROM utility_incentives ui
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON ui.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON ui.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE ui.is_active = TRUE
        AND (ui.expiration_date IS NULL OR ui.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE)
        AND 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(ui.eligible_technologies)
),
geographic_rebate_aggregation AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Aggregate rebates by geographic location
    SELECT
        COALESCE(sia.state_id, uia.state_id) AS state_id,
        COALESCE(sia.state_name, uia.state_name) AS state_name,
        COALESCE(sia.region, s.region) AS region,
        uia.utility_id,
        uia.utility_name,
        zc.zip_code,
        zc.city,
        -- Federal incentive aggregation
        COUNT(DISTINCT fia.federal_incentive_id) AS federal_incentive_count,
        SUM(fia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) AS total_federal_incentives_10kw,
        SUM(fia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) AS total_federal_incentives_5kw,
        -- State incentive aggregation
        COUNT(DISTINCT sia.state_incentive_id) AS state_incentive_count,
        SUM(sia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) AS total_state_incentives_10kw,
        SUM(sia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) AS total_state_incentives_5kw,
        -- Utility incentive aggregation
        COUNT(DISTINCT uia.utility_incentive_id) AS utility_incentive_count,
        SUM(uia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) AS total_utility_incentives_10kw,
        SUM(uia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) AS total_utility_incentives_5kw,
        -- Combined totals
        SUM(fia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) + SUM(sia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) + SUM(uia.estimated_incentive_value_10kw) AS total_combined_incentives_10kw,
        SUM(fia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) + SUM(sia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) + SUM(uia.estimated_incentive_value_5kw) AS total_combined_incentives_5kw
    FROM federal_incentive_analysis fia
    CROSS JOIN state_incentive_analysis sia
    LEFT JOIN utility_incentive_analysis uia ON sia.state_id = uia.state_id
    LEFT JOIN zip_codes zc ON sia.state_id = zc.state_id
    LEFT JOIN states s ON sia.state_id = s.state_id
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(sia.state_id, uia.state_id),
        COALESCE(sia.state_name, uia.state_name),
        COALESCE(sia.region, s.region),
        uia.utility_id,
        uia.utility_name,
        zc.zip_code,
        zc.city
),
rebate_optimization_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Optimize rebate stacking and calculate ROI
    SELECT
        gra.state_id,
        gra.state_name,
        gra.region,
        gra.utility_id,
        gra.utility_name,
        gra.zip_code,
        gra.city,
        gra.federal_incentive_count,
        gra.state_incentive_count,
        gra.utility_incentive_count,
        gra.total_federal_incentives_10kw,
        gra.total_state_incentives_10kw,
        gra.total_utility_incentives_10kw,
        gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw,
        gra.total_federal_incentives_5kw,
        gra.total_state_incentives_5kw,
        gra.total_utility_incentives_5kw,
        gra.total_combined_incentives_5kw,
        -- System cost assumptions (simplified: $3/watt)
        10000 * 3.0 AS system_cost_10kw,
        5000 * 3.0 AS system_cost_5kw,
        -- Net cost after rebates
        (10000 * 3.0) - gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw AS net_cost_10kw,
        (5000 * 3.0) - gra.total_combined_incentives_5kw AS net_cost_5kw,
        -- Rebate percentage
        CASE
            WHEN (10000 * 3.0) > 0 THEN
                (gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw / (10000 * 3.0)) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS rebate_percentage_10kw,
        CASE
            WHEN (5000 * 3.0) > 0 THEN
                (gra.total_combined_incentives_5kw / (5000 * 3.0)) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS rebate_percentage_5kw,
        -- Window functions for comparison
        AVG(gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw) OVER (
            PARTITION BY gra.state_id
        ) AS state_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
        AVG(gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw) OVER (
            PARTITION BY gra.region
        ) AS region_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY gra.state_id
            ORDER BY gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw DESC
        ) AS state_rebate_percentile,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY gra.state_id
            ORDER BY gra.total_combined_incentives_10kw DESC
        ) AS state_rebate_rank
    FROM geographic_rebate_aggregation gra
),
final_rebate_intelligence AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final rebate intelligence with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        roa.state_id,
        roa.state_name,
        roa.region,
        roa.utility_id,
        roa.utility_name,
        roa.zip_code,
        roa.city,
        roa.federal_incentive_count,
        roa.state_incentive_count,
        roa.utility_incentive_count,
        roa.federal_incentive_count + roa.state_incentive_count + roa.utility_incentive_count AS total_incentive_count,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_federal_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_federal_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_state_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_state_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_utility_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_utility_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_combined_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_combined_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_federal_incentives_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_federal_incentives_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_state_incentives_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_state_incentives_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_utility_incentives_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_utility_incentives_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.total_combined_incentives_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_combined_incentives_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.system_cost_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS system_cost_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.system_cost_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS system_cost_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.net_cost_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS net_cost_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.net_cost_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS net_cost_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.rebate_percentage_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rebate_percentage_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.rebate_percentage_5kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rebate_percentage_5kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.state_avg_total_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.region_avg_total_incentives_10kw AS NUMERIC), 2) AS region_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
        ROUND(CAST(roa.state_rebate_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_rebate_percentile,
        roa.state_rebate_rank,
        -- Rebate competitiveness classification
        CASE
            WHEN roa.total_combined_incentives_10kw > roa.state_avg_total_incentives_10kw THEN 'Above Average'
            WHEN roa.total_combined_incentives_10kw = roa.state_avg_total_incentives_10kw THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Below Average'
        END AS rebate_competitiveness
    FROM rebate_optimization_analysis roa
)
SELECT
    state_id,
    state_name,
    region,
    utility_id,
    utility_name,
    zip_code,
    city,
    federal_incentive_count,
    state_incentive_count,
    utility_incentive_count,
    total_incentive_count,
    total_federal_incentives_10kw,
    total_state_incentives_10kw,
    total_utility_incentives_10kw,
    total_combined_incentives_10kw,
    total_federal_incentives_5kw,
    total_state_incentives_5kw,
    total_utility_incentives_5kw,
    total_combined_incentives_5kw,
    system_cost_10kw,
    system_cost_5kw,
    net_cost_10kw,
    net_cost_5kw,
    rebate_percentage_10kw,
    rebate_percentage_5kw,
    state_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
    region_avg_total_incentives_10kw,
    state_rebate_percentile,
    state_rebate_rank,
    rebate_competitiveness
FROM final_rebate_intelligence
ORDER BY total_combined_incentives_10kw DESC, state_name, utility_name;

db-15.title: Historical Rate Trend Analysis with Time-Series Forecasting and Volatility Metrics
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level historical rate trend analysis with time-series analysis, rate volatility calculations, forecasting metrics, and comprehensive trend identification. Demonstrates production patterns used by energy market analysts and rate forecasting platforms. Use Case: Energy Market Analysis Platform - Historical Rate Trend Analysis and Forecasting for Energy Traders Business Value: Comprehensive historical rate trend analysis showing rate changes over time, volatility metrics, tr
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), time-series analysis, window functions with multiple frame clauses, volatility calculations, trend identification, forecasting metrics, correlated subqueries
db-15.expected_output: Historical rate trend analysis with time-series metrics, volatility calculations, and trend identification.
db-15.sql:
WITH historical_rate_timeline AS (
    -- First CTE: Build comprehensive historical rate timeline
    SELECT
        her.historical_rate_id,
        her.rate_id,
        her.utility_id,
        her.rate_code_id,
        her.state_id,
        her.effective_date,
        her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        her.fixed_charge_usd,
        her.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        her.change_type,
        her.change_percentage,
        her.change_amount,
        her.change_reason,
        uc.utility_name,
        rc.rate_code,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        -- Calculate months since start
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (her.effective_date - MIN(her.effective_date) OVER (PARTITION BY her.utility_id, her.rate_code_id))) / 2592000 AS months_since_start
    FROM historical_electricity_rates her
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON her.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON her.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON her.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE her.effective_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 years'
),
rate_change_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze rate changes with window functions
    SELECT
        hrt.*,
        -- Previous rate values
        LAG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
        ) AS prev_energy_charge,
        LEAD(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
        ) AS next_energy_charge,
        -- Rate change calculations
        hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - LAG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
        ) AS energy_charge_change,
        -- Moving averages
        AVG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_12mo,
        AVG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 23 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_avg_24mo,
        -- Moving standard deviation (volatility)
        STDDEV(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS moving_stddev_12mo,
        -- Rate trend direction
        CASE
            WHEN hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh > LAG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
                PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
                ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
            ) THEN 'Increasing'
            WHEN hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh < LAG(hrt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, 1) OVER (
                PARTITION BY hrt.utility_id, hrt.rate_code_id
                ORDER BY hrt.effective_date
            ) THEN 'Decreasing'
            ELSE 'Stable'
        END AS trend_direction
    FROM historical_rate_timeline hrt
),
volatility_metrics AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate volatility and risk metrics
    SELECT
        rca.*,
        -- Coefficient of variation (volatility measure)
        CASE
            WHEN rca.moving_avg_12mo > 0 THEN
                (rca.moving_stddev_12mo / rca.moving_avg_12mo) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS coefficient_of_variation,
        -- Rate range (max - min) over 12 months
        MAX(rca.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rca.utility_id, rca.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY rca.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) - MIN(rca.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rca.utility_id, rca.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY rca.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
