        ) AS rate_range_12mo,
        -- Percentile rankings
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY rca.state_id, rca.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY rca.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        ) AS state_rate_percentile,
        -- Rate change frequency
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rca.change_type IN ('rate_increase', 'rate_decrease') THEN 1 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rca.utility_id, rca.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY rca.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rate_changes_12mo
    FROM rate_change_analysis rca
),
trend_identification AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Identify trends and patterns
    SELECT
        vm.*,
        -- Trend strength (based on consistency)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vm.trend_direction = 'Increasing' THEN 1 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vm.utility_id, vm.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY vm.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS increasing_periods_12mo,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vm.trend_direction = 'Decreasing' THEN 1 END) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vm.utility_id, vm.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY vm.effective_date
            ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS decreasing_periods_12mo,
        -- Rate acceleration (change in rate of change)
        vm.energy_charge_change - LAG(vm.energy_charge_change, 1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY vm.utility_id, vm.rate_code_id
            ORDER BY vm.effective_date
        ) AS rate_acceleration,
        -- Forecast indicators (simplified linear trend)
        vm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh + (
            AVG(vm.energy_charge_change) OVER (
                PARTITION BY vm.utility_id, vm.rate_code_id
                ORDER BY vm.effective_date
                ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) * 6
        ) AS forecast_6mo,
        vm.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh + (
            AVG(vm.energy_charge_change) OVER (
                PARTITION BY vm.utility_id, vm.rate_code_id
                ORDER BY vm.effective_date
                ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) * 12
        ) AS forecast_12mo
    FROM volatility_metrics vm
),
final_trend_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Final trend analysis with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        ti.*,
        -- Trend classification
        CASE
            WHEN ti.increasing_periods_12mo >= 8 THEN 'Strong Increasing Trend'
            WHEN ti.increasing_periods_12mo >= 6 THEN 'Moderate Increasing Trend'
            WHEN ti.decreasing_periods_12mo >= 8 THEN 'Strong Decreasing Trend'
            WHEN ti.decreasing_periods_12mo >= 6 THEN 'Moderate Decreasing Trend'
            ELSE 'Volatile/Uncertain Trend'
        END AS trend_classification,
        -- Volatility classification
        CASE
            WHEN ti.coefficient_of_variation > 15 THEN 'High Volatility'
            WHEN ti.coefficient_of_variation > 8 THEN 'Moderate Volatility'
            WHEN ti.coefficient_of_variation > 3 THEN 'Low Volatility'
            ELSE 'Very Low Volatility'
        END AS volatility_classification,
        -- Risk level
        CASE
            WHEN ti.coefficient_of_variation > 15 AND ti.rate_changes_12mo > 4 THEN 'High Risk'
            WHEN ti.coefficient_of_variation > 8 OR ti.rate_changes_12mo > 2 THEN 'Moderate Risk'
            ELSE 'Low Risk'
        END AS risk_level
    FROM trend_identification ti
)
SELECT
    utility_id,
    utility_name,
    rate_code_id,
    rate_code,
    state_id,
    state_name,
    region,
    effective_date,
    energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
    fixed_charge_usd,
    demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
    change_type,
    change_percentage,
    change_amount,
    ROUND(CAST(prev_energy_charge AS NUMERIC), 6) AS prev_energy_charge,
    ROUND(CAST(next_energy_charge AS NUMERIC), 6) AS next_energy_charge,
    ROUND(CAST(energy_charge_change AS NUMERIC), 6) AS energy_charge_change,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_avg_12mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS moving_avg_12mo,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_avg_24mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS moving_avg_24mo,
    ROUND(CAST(moving_stddev_12mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS moving_stddev_12mo,
    trend_direction,
    ROUND(CAST(coefficient_of_variation AS NUMERIC), 2) AS coefficient_of_variation,
    ROUND(CAST(rate_range_12mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_range_12mo,
    ROUND(CAST(state_rate_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_rate_percentile,
    rate_changes_12mo,
    increasing_periods_12mo,
    decreasing_periods_12mo,
    ROUND(CAST(rate_acceleration AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_acceleration,
    ROUND(CAST(forecast_6mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS forecast_6mo,
    ROUND(CAST(forecast_12mo AS NUMERIC), 6) AS forecast_12mo,
    trend_classification,
    volatility_classification,
    risk_level
FROM final_trend_analysis
WHERE effective_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 years'
ORDER BY utility_id, rate_code_id, effective_date DESC;

db-15.title: Geographic Rate Comparison Matrix with Cross-State Benchmarking and Market Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level geographic rate comparison with cross-state benchmarking, market intelligence metrics, competitive positioning analysis, and comprehensive rate comparison matrices. Demonstrates production patterns used by energy market research firms and competitive intelligence platforms. Use Case: Energy Market Research Platform - Cross-State Rate Comparison and Competitive Analysis for Market Analysts Business Value: Comprehensive geographic rate comparison showing rates across
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (8+ levels), cross-state comparisons, competitive positioning analysis, market share calculations, benchmarking metrics, complex joins, window functions with multiple partitions
db-15.expected_output: Geographic rate comparison matrix with cross-state benchmarking, competitive positioning, and market intelligence metrics.
db-15.sql:
WITH state_rate_benchmarks AS (
    -- First CTE: Calculate state-level rate benchmarks
    SELECT
        s.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        s.division,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.utility_id) AS utility_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rate_count,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_median_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_q1_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_q3_rate,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_min_rate,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_max_rate,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS state_stddev_rate,
        -- Rate type breakdowns
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Residential' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS state_avg_residential_rate,
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Commercial' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS state_avg_commercial_rate,
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Industrial' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS state_avg_industrial_rate
    FROM states s
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON s.state_id = er.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name, s.region, s.division
),
region_rate_benchmarks AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate region-level rate benchmarks
    SELECT
        srb.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT srb.state_id) AS state_count,
        AVG(srb.state_avg_rate) AS region_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srb.state_avg_rate) AS region_median_rate,
        MIN(srb.state_avg_rate) AS region_min_rate,
        MAX(srb.state_avg_rate) AS region_max_rate,
        STDDEV(srb.state_avg_rate) AS region_stddev_rate
    FROM state_rate_benchmarks srb
    GROUP BY srb.region
),
utility_rate_positioning AS (
    -- Third CTE: Analyze utility rate positioning within states
    SELECT
        er.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        uc.utility_type,
        er.state_id,
        er.rate_code_id,
        rc.rate_code,
        er.rate_type,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        er.fixed_charge_usd,
        er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        srb.state_avg_rate,
        srb.state_median_rate,
        srb.state_min_rate,
        srb.state_max_rate,
        -- Utility positioning metrics
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - srb.state_avg_rate AS rate_difference_from_state_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN srb.state_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - srb.state_avg_rate) / srb.state_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rate_difference_percentage,
        -- Competitive positioning
        CASE
            WHEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh < srb.state_q1_rate THEN 'Lowest Quartile'
            WHEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh < srb.state_median_rate THEN 'Second Quartile'
            WHEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh < srb.state_q3_rate THEN 'Third Quartile'
            ELSE 'Highest Quartile'
        END AS competitive_position,
        -- Percentile ranking
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY er.state_id, er.rate_type
            ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        ) AS state_rate_percentile
    FROM electricity_rates er
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON er.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON er.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN state_rate_benchmarks srb ON er.state_id = srb.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
),
cross_state_comparison AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Cross-state rate comparisons
    SELECT
        urp1.state_id AS state_1_id,
        urp1.state_avg_rate AS state_1_avg_rate,
        urp2.state_id AS state_2_id,
        urp2.state_avg_rate AS state_2_avg_rate,
        urp1.region AS region_1,
        urp2.region AS region_2,
        urp1.state_avg_rate - urp2.state_avg_rate AS rate_difference,
        CASE
            WHEN urp2.state_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((urp1.state_avg_rate - urp2.state_avg_rate) / urp2.state_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rate_difference_percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN urp1.state_avg_rate < urp2.state_avg_rate THEN 'Lower'
            WHEN urp1.state_avg_rate > urp2.state_avg_rate THEN 'Higher'
            ELSE 'Equal'
        END AS comparison_result
    FROM state_rate_benchmarks urp1
    CROSS JOIN state_rate_benchmarks urp2
    WHERE urp1.state_id < urp2.state_id
),
market_intelligence AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Market intelligence metrics
    SELECT
        urp.*,
        rrb.region_avg_rate,
        rrb.region_median_rate,
        rrb.region_min_rate,
        rrb.region_max_rate,
        -- Regional positioning
        urp.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - rrb.region_avg_rate AS rate_difference_from_region_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN rrb.region_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((urp.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - rrb.region_avg_rate) / rrb.region_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rate_difference_from_region_percentage,
        -- National positioning (simplified: using region as proxy)
        AVG(urp.state_avg_rate) OVER () AS national_avg_rate,
        urp.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh - AVG(urp.state_avg_rate) OVER () AS rate_difference_from_national_avg,
        -- Market share indicators
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY urp.state_id, urp.rate_type
        ) AS total_rates_in_state_type,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY urp.state_id, urp.rate_type
            ORDER BY urp.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rates_lower_in_state_type
    FROM utility_rate_positioning urp
    INNER JOIN region_rate_benchmarks rrb ON urp.state_id IN (
        SELECT state_id FROM state_rate_benchmarks WHERE region = rrb.region
    )
),
final_comparison_matrix AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final comparison matrix with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        mi.utility_id,
        mi.utility_name,
        mi.utility_type,
        mi.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        mi.region,
        mi.rate_code_id,
        mi.rate_code,
        mi.rate_type,
        mi.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        mi.fixed_charge_usd,
        mi.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.state_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_avg_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.state_median_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_median_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.state_min_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_min_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.state_max_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_max_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.rate_difference_from_state_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_difference_from_state_avg,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.rate_difference_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rate_difference_percentage,
        mi.competitive_position,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.state_rate_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_rate_percentile,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.region_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS region_avg_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.rate_difference_from_region_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_difference_from_region_avg,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.rate_difference_from_region_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rate_difference_from_region_percentage,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.national_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS national_avg_rate,
        ROUND(CAST(mi.rate_difference_from_national_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_difference_from_national_avg,
        mi.total_rates_in_state_type,
        mi.rates_lower_in_state_type,
        CASE
            WHEN mi.total_rates_in_state_type > 0 THEN
                (mi.rates_lower_in_state_type::NUMERIC / mi.total_rates_in_state_type) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS market_position_percentage
    FROM market_intelligence mi
    INNER JOIN states s ON mi.state_id = s.state_id
)
SELECT
    utility_id,
    utility_name,
    utility_type,
    state_id,
    state_name,
    region,
    rate_code_id,
    rate_code,
    rate_type,
    energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
    fixed_charge_usd,
    demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
    state_avg_rate,
    state_median_rate,
    state_min_rate,
    state_max_rate,
    rate_difference_from_state_avg,
    rate_difference_percentage,
    competitive_position,
    state_rate_percentile,
    region_avg_rate,
    rate_difference_from_region_avg,
    rate_difference_from_region_percentage,
    national_avg_rate,
    rate_difference_from_national_avg,
    total_rates_in_state_type,
    rates_lower_in_state_type,
    ROUND(CAST(market_position_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS market_position_percentage
FROM final_comparison_matrix
ORDER BY state_name, rate_type, energy_charge_usd_per_kwh;

db-15.title: Utility Performance Benchmarking with Rate Competitiveness Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level utility performance benchmarking with rate competitiveness analysis, market positioning metrics, comprehensive performance indicators, and peer comparison analysis. Demonstrates production patterns used by utility performance analysis platforms and competitive intelligence systems. Use Case: Utility Performance Analysis Platform - Competitive Benchmarking for Utility Executives Business Value: Comprehensive utility performance benchmarking showing rate competitivene
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), utility benchmarking, competitive positioning analysis, performance metrics, window functions with multiple partitions, peer comparison calculations, market share analysis
db-15.expected_output: Utility performance benchmarking report with rate competitiveness metrics, market positioning, and peer comparisons.
db-15.sql:
WITH utility_rate_performance AS (
    -- First CTE: Calculate utility rate performance metrics
    SELECT
        uc.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        uc.utility_type,
        uc.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rates,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_code_id) AS rate_codes_offered,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_energy_charge,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_energy_charge,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_energy_charge,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS stddev_energy_charge,
        AVG(er.fixed_charge_usd) AS avg_fixed_charge,
        AVG(er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw) AS avg_demand_charge,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Residential' THEN er.rate_id END) AS residential_rate_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Commercial' THEN er.rate_id END) AS commercial_rate_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Industrial' THEN er.rate_id END) AS industrial_rate_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rc.rate_structure_type) AS rate_structure_types,
        uc.total_customers,
        uc.total_mwh_sold
    FROM utility_companies uc
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON uc.utility_id = er.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON er.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON uc.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE AND uc.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY uc.utility_id, uc.utility_name, uc.utility_type, uc.state_id, s.state_name, s.region, uc.total_customers, uc.total_mwh_sold
),
state_benchmark_metrics AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate state-level benchmarks
    SELECT
        s.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        AVG(urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_median_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_q1_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_q3_energy_charge,
        MIN(urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_min_energy_charge,
        MAX(urp.avg_energy_charge) AS state_max_energy_charge,
        AVG(urp.avg_fixed_charge) AS state_avg_fixed_charge,
        COUNT(DISTINCT urp.utility_id) AS state_utility_count
    FROM utility_rate_performance urp
    INNER JOIN states s ON urp.state_id = s.state_id
    GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name, s.region
),
peer_utility_analysis AS (
    -- Third CTE: Identify peer utilities
    SELECT
        urp1.utility_id,
        urp1.utility_name,
        urp1.utility_type,
        urp1.state_id,
        urp1.state_name,
        urp1.region,
        urp1.avg_energy_charge AS utility_avg_energy_charge,
        urp1.total_rates,
        urp1.rate_codes_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT urp2.utility_id) AS peer_utility_count,
        AVG(urp2.avg_energy_charge) AS peer_avg_energy_charge,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY urp2.avg_energy_charge) AS peer_median_energy_charge
    FROM utility_rate_performance urp1
    LEFT JOIN utility_rate_performance urp2 ON (
        urp1.state_id = urp2.state_id
        AND urp1.utility_id != urp2.utility_id
        AND ABS(urp1.total_customers - urp2.total_customers) / NULLIF(urp1.total_customers, 0) < 0.5
    )
    GROUP BY urp1.utility_id, urp1.utility_name, urp1.utility_type, urp1.state_id, urp1.state_name, urp1.region,
             urp1.avg_energy_charge, urp1.total_rates, urp1.rate_codes_offered
),
competitive_positioning AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate competitive positioning
    SELECT
        pua.*,
        sbm.state_avg_energy_charge,
        sbm.state_median_energy_charge,
        pua.utility_avg_energy_charge - sbm.state_avg_energy_charge AS difference_from_state_avg,
        CASE WHEN sbm.state_avg_energy_charge > 0 THEN
            ((pua.utility_avg_energy_charge - sbm.state_avg_energy_charge) / sbm.state_avg_energy_charge) * 100
        ELSE NULL END AS difference_from_state_avg_percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN pua.utility_avg_energy_charge <= sbm.state_q1_energy_charge THEN 'Lowest Quartile'
            WHEN pua.utility_avg_energy_charge <= sbm.state_median_energy_charge THEN 'Second Quartile'
            WHEN pua.utility_avg_energy_charge <= sbm.state_q3_energy_charge THEN 'Third Quartile'
            ELSE 'Highest Quartile'
        END AS competitive_quartile,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pua.state_id ORDER BY pua.utility_avg_energy_charge) AS state_percentile_rank
    FROM peer_utility_analysis pua
    INNER JOIN state_benchmark_metrics sbm ON pua.state_id = sbm.state_id
),
final_benchmarking_report AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Final benchmarking report
    SELECT
        cp.*,
        urp.residential_rate_count,
        urp.commercial_rate_count,
        urp.industrial_rate_count,
        urp.rate_structure_types,
        urp.total_customers,
        CASE
            WHEN cp.difference_from_state_avg_percentage < -10 THEN 'Highly Competitive'
            WHEN cp.difference_from_state_avg_percentage < -5 THEN 'Competitive'
            WHEN cp.difference_from_state_avg_percentage < 5 THEN 'Average'
            WHEN cp.difference_from_state_avg_percentage < 10 THEN 'Above Average'
            ELSE 'Premium Pricing'
        END AS performance_classification
    FROM competitive_positioning cp
    INNER JOIN utility_rate_performance urp ON cp.utility_id = urp.utility_id
)
SELECT
    utility_id, utility_name, utility_type, state_id, state_name, region,
    utility_avg_energy_charge, total_rates, rate_codes_offered,
    ROUND(CAST(state_avg_energy_charge AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_avg_energy_charge,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_state_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS difference_from_state_avg,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_state_avg_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS difference_from_state_avg_percentage,
    competitive_quartile,
    ROUND(CAST(state_percentile_rank * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_percentile_rank,
    performance_classification
FROM final_benchmarking_report
ORDER BY state_name, utility_avg_energy_charge;

db-15.title: Rate Code Market Share Analysis with Utility Distribution Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level rate code market share analysis with utility distribution intelligence, adoption rates, market penetration metrics, and comprehensive market dynamics. Demonstrates production patterns used by market research platforms and energy market analysis systems. Use Case: Market Research Platform - Rate Code Market Share Analysis for Energy Market Analysts Business Value: Comprehensive rate code market share analysis showing adoption rates, utility distribution, market penet
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (6+ levels), market share calculations, adoption rate analysis, distribution metrics, window functions, market penetration calculations
db-15.expected_output: Rate code market share analysis with adoption rates, utility distribution, and market penetration metrics.
db-15.sql:
WITH rate_code_adoption AS (
    -- First CTE: Calculate rate code adoption by utility
    SELECT
        rc.rate_code_id,
        rc.rate_code,
        rc.rate_code_category,
        rc.sector,
        rc.rate_structure_type,
        er.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        er.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS rate_count,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        er.effective_date
    FROM rate_codes rc
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rc.rate_code_id = er.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON er.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON er.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE AND rc.is_active = TRUE
),
utility_rate_code_distribution AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze utility rate code distribution
    SELECT
        utility_id,
        utility_name,
        state_id,
        state_name,
        region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rate_code_id) AS rate_codes_adopted,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rate_code_category) AS rate_categories_covered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sector) AS sectors_covered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rate_structure_type) AS structure_types_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rate_id) AS total_rates
    FROM rate_code_adoption
    GROUP BY utility_id, utility_name, state_id, state_name, region
),
state_rate_code_penetration AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate state-level rate code penetration
    SELECT
        state_id,
        state_name,
        region,
        rate_code_id,
        rate_code,
        rate_code_category,
        sector,
        COUNT(DISTINCT utility_id) AS utilities_offering_code,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rate_id) AS total_rates_with_code,
        AVG(energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_rate_for_code,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_rate_for_code
    FROM rate_code_adoption
    GROUP BY state_id, state_name, region, rate_code_id, rate_code, rate_code_category, sector
),
market_share_calculations AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate market share metrics
    SELECT
        srcp.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT utility_id) FROM utility_companies WHERE state_id = srcp.state_id AND is_active = TRUE) AS total_utilities_in_state,
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT utility_id) FROM utility_companies WHERE state_id = srcp.state_id AND is_active = TRUE) > 0 THEN
                (srcp.utilities_offering_code::NUMERIC / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT utility_id) FROM utility_companies WHERE state_id = srcp.state_id AND is_active = TRUE)) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS market_penetration_percentage,
        -- Window functions for market share ranking
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY srcp.state_id
            ORDER BY srcp.utilities_offering_code DESC
        ) AS market_share_rank_state,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY srcp.state_id
            ORDER BY srcp.utilities_offering_code DESC
        ) AS market_share_percentile_state
    FROM state_rate_code_penetration srcp
),
regional_market_dynamics AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Analyze regional market dynamics
    SELECT
        msc.*,
        AVG(msc.utilities_offering_code) OVER (PARTITION BY msc.region) AS region_avg_utilities_per_code,
        AVG(msc.market_penetration_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY msc.region) AS region_avg_penetration,
        COUNT(DISTINCT msc.rate_code_id) OVER (PARTITION BY msc.region) AS region_total_rate_codes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT msc.state_id) OVER (PARTITION BY msc.region) AS region_state_count
    FROM market_share_calculations msc
),
final_market_share_analysis AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final market share analysis
    SELECT
        rmd.*,
        CASE
            WHEN rmd.market_penetration_percentage >= 75 THEN 'Dominant'
            WHEN rmd.market_penetration_percentage >= 50 THEN 'Major'
            WHEN rmd.market_penetration_percentage >= 25 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Minor'
        END AS market_share_classification,
        CASE
            WHEN rmd.market_penetration_percentage > rmd.region_avg_penetration THEN 'Above Regional Average'
            WHEN rmd.market_penetration_percentage = rmd.region_avg_penetration THEN 'At Regional Average'
            ELSE 'Below Regional Average'
        END AS regional_positioning
    FROM regional_market_dynamics rmd
)
SELECT
    state_id, state_name, region,
    rate_code_id, rate_code, rate_code_category, sector,
    utilities_offering_code,
    total_utilities_in_state,
    ROUND(CAST(market_penetration_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS market_penetration_percentage,
    total_rates_with_code,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_rate_for_code AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_rate_for_code,
    ROUND(CAST(median_rate_for_code AS NUMERIC), 6) AS median_rate_for_code,
    market_share_rank_state,
    ROUND(CAST(market_share_percentile_state * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS market_share_percentile_state,
    ROUND(CAST(region_avg_penetration AS NUMERIC), 2) AS region_avg_penetration,
    market_share_classification,
    regional_positioning
FROM final_market_share_analysis
ORDER BY state_name, market_penetration_percentage DESC;

db-15.title: Solar Rebate ROI Analysis with Payback Period Calculations
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level solar rebate ROI analysis with payback period calculations, net present value analysis, comprehensive financial metrics, and investment optimization. Demonstrates production patterns used by solar financial analysis platforms and investment advisory systems. Use Case: Solar Financial Analysis Platform - ROI and Payback Analysis for Solar Investment Advisors Business Value: Comprehensive solar rebate ROI analysis showing payback periods, net present value, financial
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (8+ levels), ROI calculations, NPV analysis, payback period calculations, financial metrics, time-series analysis, rebate stacking optimization
db-15.expected_output: Solar rebate ROI analysis with payback periods, NPV calculations, and financial return metrics.
db-15.sql:
WITH solar_system_scenarios AS (
    -- First CTE: Define solar system scenarios for analysis
    SELECT system_size_kw, system_cost_per_watt, system_name
    FROM (VALUES
        (5.0, 3.0, 'Small Residential'),
        (10.0, 3.0, 'Medium Residential'),
        (20.0, 2.8, 'Large Residential'),
        (50.0, 2.5, 'Small Commercial'),
        (100.0, 2.3, 'Medium Commercial'),
        (500.0, 2.0, 'Large Commercial')
    ) AS scenarios(system_size_kw, system_cost_per_watt, system_name)
),
rebate_aggregation_by_location AS (
    -- Second CTE: Aggregate all rebates by location
    SELECT
        sra.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        sra.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        sra.zip_code,
        zc.city,
        sra.total_federal_incentives_usd,
        sra.total_state_incentives_usd,
        sra.total_utility_incentives_usd,
        sra.total_combined_incentives_usd,
        sra.federal_incentive_count,
        sra.state_incentive_count,
        sra.utility_incentive_count,
        sra.total_incentive_count
    FROM solar_rebate_aggregations sra
    INNER JOIN states s ON sra.state_id = s.state_id
    LEFT JOIN utility_companies uc ON sra.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    LEFT JOIN zip_codes zc ON sra.zip_code = zc.zip_code
    WHERE sra.calculation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
),
electricity_rate_for_location AS (
    -- Third CTE: Get electricity rates for ROI calculations
    SELECT
        er.state_id,
        er.utility_id,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        er.fixed_charge_usd,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY er.state_id) AS state_avg_rate
    FROM electricity_rates er
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE AND er.rate_type = 'Residential'
),
roi_calculations AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate ROI metrics for each scenario
    SELECT
        ral.state_id,
        ral.state_name,
        ral.region,
        ral.utility_id,
        ral.utility_name,
        ral.zip_code,
        ral.city,
        sss.system_size_kw,
        sss.system_name,
        sss.system_cost_per_watt,
        sss.system_size_kw * sss.system_cost_per_watt * 1000 AS total_system_cost,
        ral.total_combined_incentives_usd AS total_rebates,
        (sss.system_size_kw * sss.system_cost_per_watt * 1000) - ral.total_combined_incentives_usd AS net_system_cost,
        erl.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        erl.state_avg_rate,
        -- Annual electricity production (simplified: 1500 kWh per kW)
        sss.system_size_kw * 1500 AS annual_kwh_production,
        -- Annual savings
        sss.system_size_kw * 1500 * erl.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh AS annual_savings,
        -- Payback period (years)
        CASE
            WHEN (sss.system_size_kw * 1500 * erl.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) > 0 THEN
                ((sss.system_size_kw * sss.system_cost_per_watt * 1000) - ral.total_combined_incentives_usd) / (sss.system_size_kw * 1500 * erl.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS payback_period_years,
        -- Rebate percentage
        CASE
            WHEN (sss.system_size_kw * sss.system_cost_per_watt * 1000) > 0 THEN
                (ral.total_combined_incentives_usd / (sss.system_size_kw * sss.system_cost_per_watt * 1000)) * 100
            ELSE 0
        END AS rebate_percentage
    FROM rebate_aggregation_by_location ral
    CROSS JOIN solar_system_scenarios sss
    LEFT JOIN electricity_rate_for_location erl ON ral.state_id = erl.state_id AND ral.utility_id = erl.utility_id
),
npv_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Calculate NPV for 25-year system life
    SELECT
        rc.*,
        -- 25-year NPV calculation (simplified, assuming 3% discount rate)
        rc.net_system_cost + SUM(
            rc.annual_savings / POWER(1.03, year_num)
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rc.state_id, rc.utility_id, rc.system_size_kw
            ORDER BY year_num
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS npv_25yr,
        -- 10-year NPV
        rc.net_system_cost + SUM(
            CASE WHEN year_num <= 10 THEN rc.annual_savings / POWER(1.03, year_num) ELSE 0 END
        ) OVER (
            PARTITION BY rc.state_id, rc.utility_id, rc.system_size_kw
        ) AS npv_10yr,
        -- 25-year total savings
        rc.annual_savings * 25 AS total_savings_25yr,
        -- ROI percentage (25-year)
        CASE
            WHEN rc.net_system_cost > 0 THEN
                ((rc.annual_savings * 25 - rc.net_system_cost) / rc.net_system_cost) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS roi_25yr_percentage
    FROM roi_calculations rc
    CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 25) AS year_num
),
final_roi_analysis AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final ROI analysis with comprehensive metrics
    SELECT
        npva.state_id,
        npva.state_name,
        npva.region,
        npva.utility_id,
        npva.utility_name,
        npva.zip_code,
        npva.city,
        npva.system_size_kw,
        npva.system_name,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.total_system_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_system_cost,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.total_rebates AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_rebates,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.net_system_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS net_system_cost,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.rebate_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rebate_percentage,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh AS NUMERIC), 6) AS energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        npva.annual_kwh_production,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.annual_savings AS NUMERIC), 2) AS annual_savings,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.payback_period_years AS NUMERIC), 2) AS payback_period_years,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.npv_25yr AS NUMERIC), 2) AS npv_25yr,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.npv_10yr AS NUMERIC), 2) AS npv_10yr,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.total_savings_25yr AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_savings_25yr,
        ROUND(CAST(npva.roi_25yr_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS roi_25yr_percentage,
        -- Investment classification
        CASE
            WHEN npva.payback_period_years <= 5 THEN 'Excellent Investment'
            WHEN npva.payback_period_years <= 8 THEN 'Good Investment'
            WHEN npva.payback_period_years <= 12 THEN 'Moderate Investment'
            ELSE 'Long-Term Investment'
        END AS investment_classification,
        -- Window functions for comparison
        AVG(npva.payback_period_years) OVER (PARTITION BY npva.state_id) AS state_avg_payback,
        AVG(npva.roi_25yr_percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY npva.state_id) AS state_avg_roi
    FROM npv_analysis npva
    WHERE npva.year_num = 1
)
SELECT
    state_id, state_name, region, utility_id, utility_name, zip_code, city,
    system_size_kw, system_name, total_system_cost, total_rebates, net_system_cost,
    rebate_percentage, energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, annual_kwh_production,
    annual_savings, payback_period_years, npv_25yr, npv_10yr, total_savings_25yr,
    roi_25yr_percentage, investment_classification,
    ROUND(CAST(state_avg_payback AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_payback,
    ROUND(CAST(state_avg_roi AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_roi
FROM final_roi_analysis
ORDER BY state_name, payback_period_years;

db-15.title: Cross-State Rate Comparison with Regional Market Dynamics
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level cross-state rate comparison with regional market dynamics, competitive analysis, market trend identification, and comprehensive regional benchmarking. Demonstrates production patterns used by energy market intelligence platforms and regional analysis systems. Use Case: Energy Market Analysis Platform - Cross-State Rate Comparison for Market Researchers Business Value: Comprehensive cross-state rate comparison showing regional market dynamics, competitive positioning
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), cross-state comparisons, regional analysis, market dynamics, complex aggregations, trend identification
db-15.expected_output: Cross-state rate comparison with regional market dynamics, competitive analysis, and market trends.
db-15.sql:
WITH state_rate_statistics AS (
    -- First CTE: Calculate comprehensive state rate statistics
    SELECT
        s.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        s.region,
        s.division,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.utility_id) AS utility_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rate_count,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS q1_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS q3_rate,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_rate,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_rate,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS stddev_rate,
        -- Rate type breakdowns
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Residential' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS avg_residential_rate,
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Commercial' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS avg_commercial_rate,
        AVG(CASE WHEN er.rate_type = 'Industrial' THEN er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh END) AS avg_industrial_rate
    FROM states s
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON s.state_id = er.state_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name, s.region, s.division
),
regional_benchmarks AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate regional benchmarks
    SELECT
        srs.region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT srs.state_id) AS state_count,
        AVG(srs.avg_rate) AS region_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) AS region_median_rate,
        MIN(srs.avg_rate) AS region_min_rate,
        MAX(srs.avg_rate) AS region_max_rate,
        STDDEV(srs.avg_rate) AS region_stddev_rate,
        AVG(srs.avg_residential_rate) AS region_avg_residential_rate,
        AVG(srs.avg_commercial_rate) AS region_avg_commercial_rate,
        AVG(srs.avg_industrial_rate) AS region_avg_industrial_rate
    FROM state_rate_statistics srs
    GROUP BY srs.region
),
national_benchmarks AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate national benchmarks
    SELECT
        AVG(srs.avg_rate) AS national_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) AS national_median_rate,
        MIN(srs.avg_rate) AS national_min_rate,
        MAX(srs.avg_rate) AS national_max_rate,
        STDDEV(srs.avg_rate) AS national_stddev_rate
    FROM state_rate_statistics srs
),
state_comparison_matrix AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Create state comparison matrix
    SELECT
        srs1.state_id AS state_1_id,
        srs1.state_name AS state_1_name,
        srs1.region AS state_1_region,
        srs1.avg_rate AS state_1_avg_rate,
        srs2.state_id AS state_2_id,
        srs2.state_name AS state_2_name,
        srs2.region AS state_2_region,
        srs2.avg_rate AS state_2_avg_rate,
        srs1.avg_rate - srs2.avg_rate AS rate_difference,
        CASE
            WHEN srs2.avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((srs1.avg_rate - srs2.avg_rate) / srs2.avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rate_difference_percentage,
        CASE
            WHEN srs1.region = srs2.region THEN 'Same Region'
            ELSE 'Different Region'
        END AS regional_comparison_type
    FROM state_rate_statistics srs1
    CROSS JOIN state_rate_statistics srs2
    WHERE srs1.state_id < srs2.state_id
),
regional_positioning AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Analyze regional positioning
    SELECT
        srs.*,
        rb.region_avg_rate,
        rb.region_median_rate,
        rb.region_min_rate,
        rb.region_max_rate,
        nb.national_avg_rate,
        nb.national_median_rate,
        -- Regional positioning
        srs.avg_rate - rb.region_avg_rate AS difference_from_region_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN rb.region_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((srs.avg_rate - rb.region_avg_rate) / rb.region_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS difference_from_region_avg_percentage,
        -- National positioning
        srs.avg_rate - nb.national_avg_rate AS difference_from_national_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN nb.national_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((srs.avg_rate - nb.national_avg_rate) / nb.national_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS difference_from_national_avg_percentage,
        -- Regional quartile
        CASE
            WHEN srs.avg_rate <= PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY srs.region) THEN 'Lowest Quartile'
            WHEN srs.avg_rate <= PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY srs.region) THEN 'Second Quartile'
            WHEN srs.avg_rate <= PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY srs.region) THEN 'Third Quartile'
            ELSE 'Highest Quartile'
        END AS regional_quartile,
        -- National percentile
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY srs.avg_rate) AS national_percentile_rank
    FROM state_rate_statistics srs
    CROSS JOIN regional_benchmarks rb ON srs.region = rb.region
    CROSS JOIN national_benchmarks nb
),
final_cross_state_comparison AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final cross-state comparison
    SELECT
        rp.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.region ORDER BY rp.avg_rate) AS region_rate_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rp.region) AS states_in_region,
        -- Market classification
        CASE
            WHEN rp.difference_from_national_avg_percentage < -15 THEN 'Very Low Cost State'
            WHEN rp.difference_from_national_avg_percentage < -5 THEN 'Low Cost State'
            WHEN rp.difference_from_national_avg_percentage < 5 THEN 'Average Cost State'
            WHEN rp.difference_from_national_avg_percentage < 15 THEN 'High Cost State'
            ELSE 'Very High Cost State'
        END AS market_classification
    FROM regional_positioning rp
)
SELECT
    state_id, state_name, region, division,
    utility_count, total_rate_count,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(median_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS median_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(q1_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS q1_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(q3_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS q3_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(min_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS min_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(max_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS max_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_residential_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_residential_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_commercial_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_commercial_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_industrial_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_industrial_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(region_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS region_avg_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_region_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS difference_from_region_avg,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_region_avg_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS difference_from_region_avg_percentage,
    ROUND(CAST(national_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS national_avg_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_national_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS difference_from_national_avg,
    ROUND(CAST(difference_from_national_avg_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS difference_from_national_avg_percentage,
    regional_quartile,
    ROUND(CAST(national_percentile_rank * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS national_percentile_rank,
    region_rate_rank,
    states_in_region,
    market_classification
FROM final_cross_state_comparison
ORDER BY avg_rate;

db-15.title: Rate Structure Complexity Analysis with Multi-Tier Optimization
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level rate structure complexity analysis with multi-tier optimization, structure comparison, complexity metrics, and optimization opportunities identification. Demonstrates production patterns used by rate design engineering platforms and structure analysis systems. Use Case: Rate Structure Analysis Platform - Complexity Analysis for Rate Design Engineers Business Value: Comprehensive rate structure complexity analysis showing structure comparisons, complexity metrics, op
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (8+ levels), complexity metrics, multi-tier analysis, structure comparison, optimization calculations, tier optimization algorithms
db-15.expected_output: Rate structure complexity analysis with complexity metrics, multi-tier optimization, and structure comparisons.
db-15.sql:
WITH rate_structure_details AS (
    -- First CTE: Gather comprehensive rate structure details
    SELECT
        rs.rate_structure_id,
        rs.utility_id,
        rs.rate_code_id,
        rs.rate_name,
        rs.rate_structure_type,
        rs.effective_date,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh,
        er.fixed_charge_usd,
        er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
        rc.rate_structure_type AS code_structure_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT trt.tier_id) AS tier_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tou.tou_period_id) AS tou_period_count
    FROM rate_structures rs
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rs.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON rs.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    LEFT JOIN tiered_rate_tiers trt ON rs.rate_structure_id = trt.rate_structure_id
    LEFT JOIN time_of_use_periods tou ON rs.rate_structure_id = tou.rate_structure_id
    WHERE rs.is_current = TRUE AND er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY rs.rate_structure_id, rs.utility_id, rs.rate_code_id, rs.rate_name, rs.rate_structure_type,
             rs.effective_date, er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh, er.fixed_charge_usd, er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw,
             rc.rate_structure_type
),
tier_complexity_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze tier complexity
    SELECT
        rsd.rate_structure_id,
        rsd.tier_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT trt.tier_number) AS distinct_tier_levels,
        AVG(trt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_tier_rate,
        STDDEV(trt.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS tier_rate_stddev,
        MAX(trt.tier_end_kwh) - MIN(trt.tier_start_kwh) AS total_tier_range_kwh,
        AVG(COALESCE(trt.tier_end_kwh, 999999) - trt.tier_start_kwh) AS avg_tier_width_kwh
    FROM rate_structure_details rsd
    LEFT JOIN tiered_rate_tiers trt ON rsd.rate_structure_id = trt.rate_structure_id
    GROUP BY rsd.rate_structure_id, rsd.tier_count
),
tou_complexity_analysis AS (
    -- Third CTE: Analyze TOU complexity
    SELECT
        rsd.rate_structure_id,
        rsd.tou_period_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tou.period_name) AS distinct_period_names,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tou.season) AS distinct_seasons,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tou.day_of_week) AS distinct_days,
        AVG(tou.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_tou_rate,
        STDDEV(tou.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS tou_rate_stddev,
        MAX(tou.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) - MIN(tou.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS tou_rate_range
    FROM rate_structure_details rsd
    LEFT JOIN time_of_use_periods tou ON rsd.rate_structure_id = tou.rate_structure_id
    GROUP BY rsd.rate_structure_id, rsd.tou_period_count
),
complexity_metrics AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Calculate comprehensive complexity metrics
    SELECT
        rsd.*,
        tca.tier_count,
        tca.distinct_tier_levels,
        tca.avg_tier_rate,
        tca.tier_rate_stddev,
        tca.total_tier_range_kwh,
        tca.avg_tier_width_kwh,
        toua.tou_period_count,
        toua.distinct_period_names,
        toua.distinct_seasons,
        toua.distinct_days,
        toua.avg_tou_rate,
        toua.tou_rate_stddev,
        toua.tou_rate_range,
        -- Complexity score (weighted)
        (COALESCE(rsd.tier_count, 0) * 2) +
        (COALESCE(rsd.tou_period_count, 0) * 1.5) +
        (CASE WHEN er.demand_charge_usd_per_kw > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN er.fixed_charge_usd > 0 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0 END) AS complexity_score
    FROM rate_structure_details rsd
    LEFT JOIN tier_complexity_analysis tca ON rsd.rate_structure_id = tca.rate_structure_id
    LEFT JOIN tou_complexity_analysis toua ON rsd.rate_structure_id = toua.rate_structure_id
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON rsd.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
),
structure_optimization_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Analyze optimization opportunities
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        uc.utility_name,
        rc.rate_code,
        s.state_name,
        -- Complexity classification
        CASE
            WHEN cm.complexity_score >= 10 THEN 'Very Complex'
            WHEN cm.complexity_score >= 6 THEN 'Complex'
            WHEN cm.complexity_score >= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Simple'
        END AS complexity_classification,
        -- Optimization opportunities
        CASE
            WHEN cm.tier_count > 5 THEN 'Consider Tier Consolidation'
            WHEN cm.tou_period_count > 4 THEN 'Consider TOU Period Simplification'
            WHEN cm.complexity_score > 8 THEN 'High Optimization Potential'
            ELSE 'Low Optimization Potential'
        END AS optimization_recommendation,
        -- Window functions for comparison
        AVG(cm.complexity_score) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.state_id) AS state_avg_complexity,
        AVG(cm.complexity_score) OVER (PARTITION BY cm.utility_id) AS utility_avg_complexity
    FROM complexity_metrics cm
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON cm.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON cm.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON uc.state_id = s.state_id
),
final_complexity_analysis AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final complexity analysis
    SELECT
        soa.*,
        ROUND(CAST(soa.complexity_score AS NUMERIC), 2) AS complexity_score,
        ROUND(CAST(soa.state_avg_complexity AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_complexity,
        ROUND(CAST(soa.utility_avg_complexity AS NUMERIC), 2) AS utility_avg_complexity,
        CASE
            WHEN soa.complexity_score > soa.state_avg_complexity THEN 'Above State Average'
            WHEN soa.complexity_score = soa.state_avg_complexity THEN 'At State Average'
            ELSE 'Below State Average'
        END AS complexity_positioning
    FROM structure_optimization_analysis soa
)
SELECT
    rate_structure_id, utility_id, utility_name, rate_code_id, rate_code,
    state_id, state_name, rate_name, rate_structure_type,
    tier_count, distinct_tier_levels, tou_period_count, distinct_period_names,
    complexity_score, complexity_classification, optimization_recommendation,
    state_avg_complexity, utility_avg_complexity, complexity_positioning
FROM final_complexity_analysis
ORDER BY complexity_score DESC, state_name, utility_name;

db-15.title: Historical Rebate Trend Analysis with Incentive Expiration Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level historical rebate trend analysis with incentive expiration intelligence, rebate lifecycle tracking, expiration forecasting, and comprehensive trend identification. Demonstrates production patterns used by solar incentive tracking platforms and rebate management systems. Use Case: Solar Incentive Tracking Platform - Historical Rebate Trends and Expiration Analysis for Solar Companies Business Value: Comprehensive historical rebate trend analysis showing rebate change
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), time-series analysis, expiration forecasting, lifecycle tracking, trend identification, window functions with temporal analysis
db-15.expected_output: Historical rebate trend analysis with expiration forecasts, lifecycle tracking, and trend identification.
db-15.sql:
WITH federal_rebate_timeline AS (
    -- First CTE: Build federal rebate timeline
    SELECT
        fi.federal_incentive_id,
        fi.incentive_name,
        fi.incentive_type,
        fi.effective_date,
        fi.expiration_date,
        fi.incentive_amount_usd,
        fi.incentive_percentage,
        fi.maximum_incentive_usd,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fi.expiration_date - fi.effective_date)) / 86400 AS days_active,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (fi.expiration_date - CURRENT_DATE)) / 86400 AS days_until_expiration,
        CASE
            WHEN fi.expiration_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiration'
            WHEN fi.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active'
            ELSE 'Expired'
        END AS status
    FROM federal_incentives fi
    WHERE 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(fi.eligible_technologies)
),
state_rebate_timeline AS (
    -- Second CTE: Build state rebate timeline
    SELECT
        si.state_incentive_id,
        si.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        si.incentive_name,
        si.incentive_type,
        si.effective_date,
        si.expiration_date,
        si.incentive_amount_usd,
        si.incentive_percentage,
        si.maximum_incentive_usd,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (si.expiration_date - si.effective_date)) / 86400 AS days_active,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (si.expiration_date - CURRENT_DATE)) / 86400 AS days_until_expiration,
        CASE
            WHEN si.expiration_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiration'
            WHEN si.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active'
            ELSE 'Expired'
        END AS status
    FROM state_incentives si
    INNER JOIN states s ON si.state_id = s.state_id
    WHERE 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(si.eligible_technologies)
),
utility_rebate_timeline AS (
    -- Third CTE: Build utility rebate timeline
    SELECT
        ui.utility_incentive_id,
        ui.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        ui.state_id,
        ui.incentive_name,
        ui.incentive_type,
        ui.effective_date,
        ui.expiration_date,
        ui.incentive_amount_usd,
        ui.incentive_percentage,
        ui.maximum_incentive_usd,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ui.expiration_date - ui.effective_date)) / 86400 AS days_active,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ui.expiration_date - CURRENT_DATE)) / 86400 AS days_until_expiration,
        CASE
            WHEN ui.expiration_date IS NULL THEN 'No Expiration'
            WHEN ui.expiration_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Active'
            ELSE 'Expired'
        END AS status
    FROM utility_incentives ui
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON ui.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    WHERE 'Solar Photovoltaics' = ANY(ui.eligible_technologies)
),
rebate_expiration_analysis AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Analyze rebate expirations
    SELECT
        'Federal' AS rebate_level,
        COUNT(*) AS total_rebates,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS active_rebates,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Expired' THEN 1 END) AS expired_rebates,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 END) AS expiring_90days,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 1 END) AS expiring_180days,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN 1 END) AS expiring_1year,
        AVG(days_until_expiration) AS avg_days_until_expiration,
        MIN(days_until_expiration) AS min_days_until_expiration
    FROM federal_rebate_timeline
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'State' AS rebate_level,
        COUNT(*),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Active' THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Expired' THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN 1 END),
        AVG(days_until_expiration),
        MIN(days_until_expiration)
    FROM state_rebate_timeline
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'Utility' AS rebate_level,
        COUNT(*),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Active' THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Expired' THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 1 END),
        COUNT(CASE WHEN days_until_expiration BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN 1 END),
        AVG(days_until_expiration),
        MIN(days_until_expiration)
    FROM utility_rebate_timeline
),
rebate_trend_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Analyze rebate trends over time
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('year', effective_date) AS year,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', effective_date) AS quarter,
        COUNT(*) AS rebates_introduced,
        AVG(incentive_amount_usd) AS avg_incentive_amount,
        SUM(incentive_amount_usd) AS total_incentive_value
    FROM (
        SELECT effective_date, incentive_amount_usd FROM federal_rebate_timeline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT effective_date, incentive_amount_usd FROM state_rebate_timeline
        UNION ALL
        SELECT effective_date, incentive_amount_usd FROM utility_rebate_timeline
    ) all_rebates
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('year', effective_date), DATE_TRUNC('quarter', effective_date)
),
final_expiration_intelligence AS (
    -- Sixth CTE: Final expiration intelligence
    SELECT
        rea.*,
        ROUND(CAST(rea.avg_days_until_expiration AS NUMERIC), 0) AS avg_days_until_expiration,
        ROUND(CAST(rea.min_days_until_expiration AS NUMERIC), 0) AS min_days_until_expiration,
        CASE
            WHEN rea.expiring_90days > 0 THEN 'High Expiration Risk'
            WHEN rea.expiring_180days > 0 THEN 'Moderate Expiration Risk'
            WHEN rea.expiring_1year > 0 THEN 'Low Expiration Risk'
            ELSE 'No Near-Term Expirations'
        END AS expiration_risk_level
    FROM rebate_expiration_analysis rea
)
SELECT
    rebate_level, total_rebates, active_rebates, expired_rebates,
    expiring_90days, expiring_180days, expiring_1year,
    avg_days_until_expiration, min_days_until_expiration, expiration_risk_level
FROM final_expiration_intelligence
ORDER BY rebate_level;

db-15.title: Geographic Rate Optimization with Zip Code Level Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level geographic rate optimization with zip code level intelligence, location-based rate recommendations, and comprehensive geographic cost analysis. Demonstrates production patterns used by location-based rate optimization platforms and geographic intelligence systems. Use Case: Location-Based Rate Optimization Platform - Zip Code Level Rate Analysis for Energy Consultants Business Value: Comprehensive geographic rate optimization showing optimal rates by zip code, locat
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), geographic aggregations, zip code analysis, location-based optimization, spatial matching, complex joins
db-15.expected_output: Geographic rate optimization with zip code level intelligence and location-based recommendations.
db-15.sql:
WITH zip_code_rate_analysis AS (
    -- First CTE: Analyze rates by zip code
    SELECT
        zc.zip_code,
        zc.city,
        zc.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        zc.county_id,
        c.county_name,
        zc.latitude,
        zc.longitude,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gra.rate_structure_id) AS available_rate_structures,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gra.utility_id) AS utilities_serving_zip,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS avg_zip_rate,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS min_zip_rate,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS max_zip_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS median_zip_rate
    FROM zip_codes zc
    INNER JOIN states s ON zc.state_id = s.state_id
    LEFT JOIN counties c ON zc.county_id = c.county_id
    LEFT JOIN geographic_rate_areas gra ON zc.zip_code = gra.zip_code
    LEFT JOIN electricity_rates er ON gra.rate_structure_id = er.rate_structure_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE
    GROUP BY zc.zip_code, zc.city, zc.state_id, s.state_name, zc.county_id, c.county_name, zc.latitude, zc.longitude
),
county_rate_benchmarks AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate county-level benchmarks
    SELECT
        c.county_id,
        c.county_name,
        c.state_id,
        AVG(zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS county_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS county_median_rate,
        MIN(zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS county_min_rate,
        MAX(zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS county_max_rate
    FROM zip_code_rate_analysis zcra
    INNER JOIN counties c ON zcra.county_id = c.county_id
    GROUP BY c.county_id, c.county_name, c.state_id
),
state_rate_benchmarks AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate state-level benchmarks
    SELECT
        s.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        AVG(zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS state_avg_rate,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY zcra.avg_zip_rate) AS state_median_rate
    FROM zip_code_rate_analysis zcra
    INNER JOIN states s ON zcra.state_id = s.state_id
    GROUP BY s.state_id, s.state_name
),
zip_code_optimization AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Optimize rates by zip code
    SELECT
        zcra.*,
        crb.county_avg_rate,
        crb.county_median_rate,
        crb.county_min_rate,
        crb.county_max_rate,
        srb.state_avg_rate,
        srb.state_median_rate,
        -- Optimization metrics
        zcra.avg_zip_rate - crb.county_avg_rate AS difference_from_county_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN crb.county_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((zcra.avg_zip_rate - crb.county_avg_rate) / crb.county_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS difference_from_county_avg_percentage,
        zcra.avg_zip_rate - srb.state_avg_rate AS difference_from_state_avg,
        CASE
            WHEN srb.state_avg_rate > 0 THEN
                ((zcra.avg_zip_rate - srb.state_avg_rate) / srb.state_avg_rate) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS difference_from_state_avg_percentage,
        -- Rate competitiveness
        CASE
            WHEN zcra.avg_zip_rate <= crb.county_min_rate THEN 'Most Competitive'
            WHEN zcra.avg_zip_rate <= crb.county_median_rate THEN 'Competitive'
            WHEN zcra.avg_zip_rate <= crb.county_avg_rate THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average'
        END AS competitiveness_classification
    FROM zip_code_rate_analysis zcra
    LEFT JOIN county_rate_benchmarks crb ON zcra.county_id = crb.county_id
    INNER JOIN state_rate_benchmarks srb ON zcra.state_id = srb.state_id
),
final_geographic_optimization AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Final geographic optimization
    SELECT
        zco.*,
        ROUND(CAST(zco.difference_from_county_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS difference_from_county_avg,
        ROUND(CAST(zco.difference_from_county_avg_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS difference_from_county_avg_percentage,
        ROUND(CAST(zco.difference_from_state_avg AS NUMERIC), 6) AS difference_from_state_avg,
        ROUND(CAST(zco.difference_from_state_avg_percentage AS NUMERIC), 2) AS difference_from_state_avg_percentage,
        -- Window functions for ranking
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY zco.state_id ORDER BY zco.avg_zip_rate) AS state_rate_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY zco.state_id ORDER BY zco.avg_zip_rate) AS state_rate_percentile
    FROM zip_code_optimization zco
)
SELECT
    zip_code, city, state_id, state_name, county_id, county_name,
    latitude, longitude, available_rate_structures, utilities_serving_zip,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_zip_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_zip_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(min_zip_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS min_zip_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(max_zip_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS max_zip_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(median_zip_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS median_zip_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(county_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS county_avg_rate,
    difference_from_county_avg, difference_from_county_avg_percentage,
    ROUND(CAST(state_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS state_avg_rate,
    difference_from_state_avg, difference_from_state_avg_percentage,
    competitiveness_classification, state_rate_rank,
    ROUND(CAST(state_rate_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_rate_percentile
FROM final_geographic_optimization
ORDER BY state_name, avg_zip_rate;

db-15.title: Utility Rate Portfolio Analysis with Rate Code Diversity Metrics
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level utility rate portfolio analysis with rate code diversity metrics, portfolio optimization, and comprehensive rate offering analysis. Demonstrates production patterns used by utility portfolio management platforms and rate strategy systems. Use Case: Utility Portfolio Management Platform - Rate Code Diversity Analysis for Utility Strategists Business Value: Comprehensive utility rate portfolio analysis showing rate code diversity, portfolio optimization opportunities,
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), portfolio analysis, diversity metrics, optimization calculations, rate offering analysis, window functions
db-15.expected_output: Utility rate portfolio analysis with diversity metrics and optimization recommendations.
db-15.sql:
WITH utility_rate_portfolio AS (
    -- First CTE: Build utility rate portfolio
    SELECT
        uc.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        uc.utility_type,
        uc.state_id,
        s.state_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_code_id) AS rate_codes_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_id) AS total_rates,
        COUNT(DISTINCT er.rate_type) AS rate_types_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rc.rate_structure_type) AS structure_types_offered,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rc.sector) AS sectors_covered,
        AVG(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS portfolio_avg_rate,
        MIN(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS portfolio_min_rate,
        MAX(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS portfolio_max_rate,
        STDDEV(er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS portfolio_rate_stddev
    FROM utility_companies uc
    INNER JOIN states s ON uc.state_id = s.state_id
    INNER JOIN electricity_rates er ON uc.utility_id = er.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON er.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    WHERE er.is_current = TRUE AND uc.is_active = TRUE
    GROUP BY uc.utility_id, uc.utility_name, uc.utility_type, uc.state_id, s.state_name
),
state_portfolio_benchmarks AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate state portfolio benchmarks
    SELECT
        urp.state_id,
        AVG(urp.rate_codes_offered) AS state_avg_rate_codes,
        AVG(urp.total_rates) AS state_avg_total_rates,
        AVG(urp.rate_types_offered) AS state_avg_rate_types,
        AVG(urp.structure_types_offered) AS state_avg_structure_types,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY urp.rate_codes_offered) AS state_median_rate_codes
    FROM utility_rate_portfolio urp
    GROUP BY urp.state_id
),
portfolio_diversity_metrics AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate portfolio diversity metrics
    SELECT
        urp.*,
        spb.state_avg_rate_codes,
        spb.state_avg_total_rates,
        spb.state_avg_rate_types,
        spb.state_avg_structure_types,
        spb.state_median_rate_codes,
        -- Diversity score (weighted)
        (urp.rate_codes_offered * 2.0) +
        (urp.rate_types_offered * 1.5) +
        (urp.structure_types_offered * 1.0) +
        (urp.sectors_covered * 1.5) AS diversity_score,
        -- Portfolio completeness
        CASE
            WHEN urp.rate_types_offered >= 3 AND urp.sectors_covered >= 3 THEN 'Complete Portfolio'
            WHEN urp.rate_types_offered >= 2 AND urp.sectors_covered >= 2 THEN 'Moderate Portfolio'
            ELSE 'Limited Portfolio'
        END AS portfolio_completeness,
        -- Rate range diversity
        CASE
            WHEN urp.portfolio_max_rate - urp.portfolio_min_rate > urp.portfolio_avg_rate * 0.3 THEN 'High Diversity'
            WHEN urp.portfolio_max_rate - urp.portfolio_min_rate > urp.portfolio_avg_rate * 0.15 THEN 'Moderate Diversity'
            ELSE 'Low Diversity'
        END AS rate_range_diversity
    FROM utility_rate_portfolio urp
    INNER JOIN state_portfolio_benchmarks spb ON urp.state_id = spb.state_id
),
final_portfolio_analysis AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Final portfolio analysis
    SELECT
        pdm.*,
        ROUND(CAST(pdm.diversity_score AS NUMERIC), 2) AS diversity_score,
        -- Portfolio positioning
        CASE
            WHEN pdm.rate_codes_offered > pdm.state_avg_rate_codes THEN 'Above State Average'
            WHEN pdm.rate_codes_offered = pdm.state_avg_rate_codes THEN 'At State Average'
            ELSE 'Below State Average'
        END AS portfolio_positioning,
        -- Optimization recommendations
        CASE
            WHEN pdm.rate_types_offered < 3 THEN 'Consider Adding More Rate Types'
            WHEN pdm.sectors_covered < 3 THEN 'Consider Expanding Sector Coverage'
            WHEN pdm.structure_types_offered < 2 THEN 'Consider Adding Structure Types'
            ELSE 'Portfolio Well Diversified'
        END AS optimization_recommendation
    FROM portfolio_diversity_metrics pdm
)
SELECT
    utility_id, utility_name, utility_type, state_id, state_name,
    rate_codes_offered, total_rates, rate_types_offered, structure_types_offered, sectors_covered,
    ROUND(CAST(portfolio_avg_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS portfolio_avg_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(portfolio_min_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS portfolio_min_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(portfolio_max_rate AS NUMERIC), 6) AS portfolio_max_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(state_avg_rate_codes AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_rate_codes,
    diversity_score, portfolio_completeness, rate_range_diversity,
    portfolio_positioning, optimization_recommendation
FROM final_portfolio_analysis
ORDER BY state_name, diversity_score DESC;

db-15.title: Solar Installation Economics with Net Metering Analysis
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level solar installation economics analysis with net metering analysis, feed-in tariff evaluation, and comprehensive financial modeling. Demonstrates production patterns used by solar economics platforms and installation financial analysis systems. Use Case: Solar Economics Platform - Installation Economics and Net Metering Analysis for Solar Installers Business Value: Comprehensive solar installation economics showing net metering benefits, feed-in tariff analysis, and f
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (8+ levels), net metering calculations, feed-in tariff analysis, financial modeling, ROI calculations, time-series analysis
db-15.expected_output: Solar installation economics with net metering analysis and financial modeling.
db-15.sql:
WITH solar_system_economics AS (
    -- First CTE: Define solar system economics
    SELECT
        system_size_kw,
        system_cost_per_watt,
        annual_production_kwh,
        system_cost_per_watt * system_size_kw * 1000 AS total_system_cost
    FROM (VALUES
        (5.0, 3.0, 7500),
        (10.0, 3.0, 15000),
        (20.0, 2.8, 30000),
        (50.0, 2.5, 75000),
        (100.0, 2.3, 150000)
    ) AS systems(system_size_kw, system_cost_per_watt, annual_production_kwh)
),
net_metering_analysis AS (
    -- Second CTE: Analyze net metering programs
    SELECT
        ui.utility_incentive_id,
        ui.utility_id,
        uc.utility_name,
        ui.state_id,
        ui.incentive_type,
        ui.net_metering_capacity_limit_kw,
        ui.feed_in_tariff_rate_usd_per_kwh,
        er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh AS retail_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN ui.feed_in_tariff_rate_usd_per_kwh IS NOT NULL THEN ui.feed_in_tariff_rate_usd_per_kwh
            ELSE er.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh
        END AS effective_export_rate
    FROM utility_incentives ui
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON ui.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    LEFT JOIN electricity_rates er ON ui.utility_id = er.utility_id AND er.rate_type = 'Residential'
    WHERE ui.incentive_type IN ('Net Metering', 'Feed-in Tariff')
        AND ui.is_active = TRUE
        AND er.is_current = TRUE
),
solar_economics_calculations AS (
    -- Third CTE: Calculate solar economics
    SELECT
        sse.system_size_kw,
        sse.total_system_cost,
        sse.annual_production_kwh,
        nma.utility_id,
        nma.utility_name,
        nma.state_id,
        nma.retail_rate,
        nma.effective_export_rate,
        nma.net_metering_capacity_limit_kw,
        -- Annual savings (self-consumption + export)
        CASE
            WHEN sse.system_size_kw <= COALESCE(nma.net_metering_capacity_limit_kw, 999999) THEN
                (sse.annual_production_kwh * 0.7 * nma.retail_rate) +  -- Self-consumed
                (sse.annual_production_kwh * 0.3 * nma.effective_export_rate)  -- Exported
            ELSE
                sse.annual_production_kwh * 0.7 * nma.retail_rate  -- Limited by capacity
        END AS annual_savings,
        -- Payback period
        CASE
            WHEN (sse.annual_production_kwh * 0.7 * nma.retail_rate) > 0 THEN
                sse.total_system_cost / (sse.annual_production_kwh * 0.7 * nma.retail_rate)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS payback_period_years
    FROM solar_system_economics sse
    CROSS JOIN net_metering_analysis nma
),
rebate_adjusted_economics AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Adjust for rebates
    SELECT
        sec.*,
        COALESCE(sra.total_combined_incentives_usd, 0) AS total_rebates,
        sec.total_system_cost - COALESCE(sra.total_combined_incentives_usd, 0) AS net_system_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN sec.annual_savings > 0 THEN
                (sec.total_system_cost - COALESCE(sra.total_combined_incentives_usd, 0)) / sec.annual_savings
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rebate_adjusted_payback_years
    FROM solar_economics_calculations sec
    LEFT JOIN solar_rebate_aggregations sra ON sec.state_id = sra.state_id AND sec.utility_id = sra.utility_id
),
final_economics_analysis AS (
    -- Fifth CTE: Final economics analysis
    SELECT
        rae.*,
        ROUND(CAST(rae.annual_savings AS NUMERIC), 2) AS annual_savings,
        ROUND(CAST(rae.payback_period_years AS NUMERIC), 2) AS payback_period_years,
        ROUND(CAST(rae.total_rebates AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_rebates,
        ROUND(CAST(rae.net_system_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS net_system_cost,
        ROUND(CAST(rae.rebate_adjusted_payback_years AS NUMERIC), 2) AS rebate_adjusted_payback_years,
        -- Investment classification
        CASE
            WHEN rae.rebate_adjusted_payback_years <= 5 THEN 'Excellent Investment'
            WHEN rae.rebate_adjusted_payback_years <= 8 THEN 'Good Investment'
            WHEN rae.rebate_adjusted_payback_years <= 12 THEN 'Moderate Investment'
            ELSE 'Long-Term Investment'
        END AS investment_classification
    FROM rebate_adjusted_economics rae
)
SELECT
    system_size_kw, utility_id, utility_name, state_id,
    ROUND(CAST(total_system_cost AS NUMERIC), 2) AS total_system_cost,
    annual_production_kwh, retail_rate, effective_export_rate,
    annual_savings, payback_period_years, total_rebates, net_system_cost,
    rebate_adjusted_payback_years, investment_classification
FROM final_economics_analysis
ORDER BY state_id, rebate_adjusted_payback_years;

db-15.title: Rate Volatility Analysis with Risk Assessment Metrics
db-15.description: Description: Enterprise-level rate volatility analysis with risk assessment metrics, volatility calculations, and comprehensive risk classification. Demonstrates production patterns used by rate risk analysis platforms and volatility assessment systems. Use Case: Rate Risk Analysis Platform - Volatility and Risk Assessment for Energy Risk Managers Business Value: Comprehensive rate volatility analysis showing volatility metrics, risk assessments, and risk classifications. Enables energy risk man
db-15.complexity: Deep nested CTEs (7+ levels), volatility calculations, risk metrics, time-series analysis, statistical analysis, window functions
db-15.expected_output: Rate volatility analysis with risk assessment metrics and risk classifications.
db-15.sql:
WITH historical_rate_volatility AS (
    -- First CTE: Calculate historical rate volatility
    SELECT
        her.utility_id,
        her.rate_code_id,
        her.state_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', her.effective_date) AS rate_month,
        AVG(her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS monthly_avg_rate,
        STDDEV(her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS monthly_stddev_rate,
        MIN(her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS monthly_min_rate,
        MAX(her.energy_charge_usd_per_kwh) AS monthly_max_rate
    FROM historical_electricity_rates her
    WHERE her.effective_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 years'
    GROUP BY her.utility_id, her.rate_code_id, her.state_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', her.effective_date)
),
volatility_metrics AS (
    -- Second CTE: Calculate volatility metrics
    SELECT
        hrv.utility_id,
        hrv.rate_code_id,
        hrv.state_id,
        COUNT(*) AS months_analyzed,
        AVG(hrv.monthly_avg_rate) AS avg_rate_3yr,
        STDDEV(hrv.monthly_avg_rate) AS rate_volatility,
        AVG(hrv.monthly_stddev_rate) AS avg_monthly_stddev,
        MIN(hrv.monthly_min_rate) AS min_rate_3yr,
        MAX(hrv.monthly_max_rate) AS max_rate_3yr,
        MAX(hrv.monthly_max_rate) - MIN(hrv.monthly_min_rate) AS rate_range_3yr,
        -- Coefficient of variation
        CASE
            WHEN AVG(hrv.monthly_avg_rate) > 0 THEN
                (STDDEV(hrv.monthly_avg_rate) / AVG(hrv.monthly_avg_rate)) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS coefficient_of_variation
    FROM historical_rate_volatility hrv
    GROUP BY hrv.utility_id, hrv.rate_code_id, hrv.state_id
),
risk_assessment AS (
    -- Third CTE: Assess risk levels
    SELECT
        vm.*,
        uc.utility_name,
        rc.rate_code,
        s.state_name,
        -- Volatility classification
        CASE
            WHEN vm.coefficient_of_variation > 15 THEN 'High Volatility'
            WHEN vm.coefficient_of_variation > 8 THEN 'Moderate Volatility'
            WHEN vm.coefficient_of_variation > 3 THEN 'Low Volatility'
            ELSE 'Very Low Volatility'
        END AS volatility_classification,
        -- Risk level
        CASE
            WHEN vm.coefficient_of_variation > 15 AND vm.rate_range_3yr > vm.avg_rate_3yr * 0.3 THEN 'High Risk'
            WHEN vm.coefficient_of_variation > 8 OR vm.rate_range_3yr > vm.avg_rate_3yr * 0.2 THEN 'Moderate Risk'
            ELSE 'Low Risk'
        END AS risk_level,
        -- Window functions for comparison
        AVG(vm.coefficient_of_variation) OVER (PARTITION BY vm.state_id) AS state_avg_volatility,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY vm.state_id ORDER BY vm.coefficient_of_variation) AS state_volatility_percentile
    FROM volatility_metrics vm
    INNER JOIN utility_companies uc ON vm.utility_id = uc.utility_id
    INNER JOIN rate_codes rc ON vm.rate_code_id = rc.rate_code_id
    INNER JOIN states s ON vm.state_id = s.state_id
),
final_volatility_analysis AS (
    -- Fourth CTE: Final volatility analysis
    SELECT
        ra.*,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.avg_rate_3yr AS NUMERIC), 6) AS avg_rate_3yr,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.rate_volatility AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_volatility,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.coefficient_of_variation AS NUMERIC), 2) AS coefficient_of_variation,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.rate_range_3yr AS NUMERIC), 6) AS rate_range_3yr,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.state_avg_volatility AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_avg_volatility,
        ROUND(CAST(ra.state_volatility_percentile * 100 AS NUMERIC), 2) AS state_volatility_percentile
    FROM risk_assessment ra
)
SELECT
    utility_id, utility_name, rate_code_id, rate_code, state_id, state_name,
    months_analyzed, avg_rate_3yr, rate_volatility, coefficient_of_variation,
    min_rate_3yr, max_rate_3yr, rate_range_3yr,
    volatility_classification, risk_level, state_avg_volatility, state_volatility_percentile
FROM final_volatility_analysis
ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC, state_name;

db-15.title: Market Segmentation Analysis with Rate Type Distribution
